e3d0af2bc33e0548cfb6.title: Medical Practice Coordinator-Dermatology
e3d0af2bc33e0548cfb6.description:
Nemours is seeking a Medical Practice Coordinator-Dermatology to join us at our main campus in Wilmington, DE. Monday-Friday 8-430pm shift with rotation 830-5pm

**Primary Functions:**

* Facilitate access to care. This includes scheduling of patients at all Nemours sites of service. Maximize template utilization. Manage the wait list and referral work queue to ensure it is at or below established metrics.

* Manage divisional templates to ensure ease of patient access, provider effectiveness and efficient clinic flow.

* Provide daily administrative support to assigned members of the clinical team; including the Division Chief. Assist in the coordination and support of enterprise/departmental/divisional projects and initiative which further the clinical, educational and research missions of the Department of Pediatrics and its Divisions.

**Essential Functions:**

* Provide daily oversight of divisional clinical schedules and EPIC templates.

  + In collaboration with departmental/divisional leadership and divisional providers, develop, build, modify and maintain EPIC templates for assigned providers and specialty programs at all service sites.
  + View and manage provider schedules. Complete steps within EPIC to set single day edits, unavailable times, hold times and clinic cancellations as required.
  + Utilizing EPIC and Qlik reporting tools, assess template effectiveness through the lens of patient access for all appointment types, provider productivity and care center efficiency. Process template revisions as appropriate.

* Promptly and courteously handle telephone calls to/from internal and external customers including patients, referring physicians, insurance companies, etc. Triage urgent/non-urgent calls appropriately. Ensure service excellence in all encounters.

* Provide administrative support to divisional leaders and clinical providers, to include, but not limited to:

  + Daily, detailed management of administrative and clinical schedule of activities.
  + Coordination of meetings with internal and external participants
  + Ensure alignment between Outlook and Epic schedules.
  + Timely completion of hospital reappointment applications
  + Maintain an accurate accounting of continuing medical education (CME) activity
  + Update and maintain the curriculum vitae (CV) for providers on an ongoing basis.
  + Participate in the development and distribution of monthly divisional on-call schedules. Ensure internal and external partners have accurate on-call information. Enter into Web Exchange.
  + Manage the biweekly and monthly Kronos (timekeeping) and Paid Time off (PTO) process for assigned Department/Division personnel. Maintain time and leave records.
  + On a daily basis, open, categorize and distribute incoming correspondence, including mail, faxes, scanned documents, etc.
  + Complete associate reimbursement forms, payment requests forms, license renewals, etc. Maintain an accounting of identified expenses. Prepare CME travel request forms; coordinate travel request forms as directed.
  + Physical onsite presence as required by Division.

* Proactively identify problems and opportunities related to divisional operations. Address or refer problems and ideas appropriately.

* The most significant duties and requirements of this job at this time have been included in this position description. Other duties may be assigned as needed. Nemours reserves the right to modify job responsibilities as needed and without notice to meet its business needs.

**Job Requirements:**

High School Diploma required. Associate or bachelor's degree preferred, but will consider equivalent

years’ experience and enrollment in degreed program.

1-3 years of job-related experience required.

*Fully Remote in the states of: Arizona, California, Colorado, Illinois, Iowa, Kentucky, Michigan, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Texas, Utah, or Washington*  
  
**THE JOB**  
Are you a relationship builder who thrives on creative thinking and strategic problem-solving? Do you enjoy the excitement of sales but prefer focusing on advising clients, shaping ideas, and bringing standout merchandise projects to life? As a Creative Project Manager, you will be the entrusted expert on our products and services. You will seize the opportunity to consult with clients on high impact projects that elevate their brand. You’ll push creative boundaries, presenting fresh, innovative merchandise solutions that set both your clients and Kotis apart from the competition. This is a fully remote position.  
  
**WHY YOU'LL LOVE US**

* Remote done right. We’re passionate about face time and your location will never be a barrier to meaningful interactions. Since 2015, we've had fully remote teams and have created a thriving culture around remote team collaboration and camaraderie. We’ll give you all the tech and support to make it easy. We have zero plans to have employees return to an office.
* A culture of flexibility. We want you to love your job and we believe that includes the ability to invest in your passions outside of the workplace.
* Grow your career. We have clearly defined career paths that help support both professional development and pay equity. This includes sales training, interpersonal skills development, and regular pay reviews.
* Office Stipend. $500 yearly office stipend to make your home office magazine worthy.
* Virtual events. Beyond our department meetings, our employees can participate in other virtual events. Departments compete against each other playing Pictionary or Scattegories, answer fun and unique questions in watercoolers, or even participate in chocolate tastings. We hold virtual mindfulness groups where anyone can join.
* PTO. We offer generous Paid Time Off in addition to our culture of flexibility, so you’ll be well rested and relaxed to bring your best self to work.
* Swag. We make amazing swag, and often that comes with sampling our swag to ensure we’ll thrill our clients.

  
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Takes full ownership driving day-to-day operations; planning and overseeing all aspects of your client’s brand strategy, from overseeing project management product pitching and developing timeline, to ensuring a successful project outcome.
* Responsible for fostering and maintaining strong client relationships through effective communication, active listening, a proactive mindset and strategic consultation.
* Prioritize high impact‑ activities, including account strategy, growth and projection planning and sending proactive ideas.
* Keep current on trends to push the creative envelope to showcase ideas that haven’t been done to set your client and Kotis apart from competitors.
* Oversee your own dedicated support assistant who handles non client facing admin tasks, allowing you to focus on driving projects forward, proactive planning, and being a strong creative resource for clients
* Proactively close inbound projects (while earning a monthly bonus) and retain customer revenue while identifying upsell and growth opportunities.
* Work in tandem with your Platform Success Manager to land business and make Kotis the “one stop shop” for all your client’s merchandise.
* Prioritizes a constant stream of high volume, urgent inquiries with a calm demeanor and addresses client concerns and questions promptly.

  
**REQUIREMENTS**

* 5+ years Project Management, Account Management, or Sales experience required.
* Strong PC skills and experience working with Microsoft Office suite required.
* Creative with proven track record of strong project management skills
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to handle a high volume of work in a fast-paced environment with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* AA, BS/BA or equivalent experience.

  
**COMPENSATION**  
$77,500-87,500 annual with uncapped bonus potential. Estimated year one $15,000+, team bonus average from 2025 $29,000+.  
  
*Kotis Design is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to recruiting and employing highly qualified individuals who represent the diverse communities in which we live, and with whom we work. We base our personnel decisions on merit, qualifications, performance, and business needs. All employment-related decisions are made without unlawful discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, age, marital status, physical, sensory, or mental disability, military status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, political ideology, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual assault, or stalking, or any other factor determined to be unlawful by applicable federal, state or local statutes. * Competitive pay.
* Creative, collaborative, and friendly work environment.
* Opportunity to work with a wide range of great clients in different industries.

Key Responsibilities:

* Track project timelines and deliverables in project management tools (e.g., Monday)

----------------------------

To get started, simply fill out the form below.
  
  
We'll consider **US-based candidates only**, preferably in Miami or Los Angeles. For creative positions, your **portfolio is required**.

d52796c21dd3972d677b.title: Subsidy Coordinator (Remote)
d52796c21dd3972d677b.description:
At WinnCompanies, our work starts with people — the residents who call our communities home, the neighborhoods we help strengthen, and the 4,600+ team members across 30 states, Washington, D.C., and Puerto Rico who make it all possible. As an award-winning owner, developer, and manager of high-impact, mixed-income apartment communities, we are proud to be one of the nation’s leading managers of multifamily housing and one of the largest operators of affordable housing communities.
  
  
We bring together people who care about quality housing, meaningful service, and making a difference every day. Through our innovative resident services platform and commitment to exceptional communities, we offer career opportunities for individuals who want their work to create lasting impact.
  
  
Interested in learning more? Visit WinnCompanies to explore our benefits, mission, communities, and career opportunities.
  
  
About the Opportunity
  
WinnCompanies is looking for Subsidy Coordinator to join our corporate Compliance team.
  
The Subsidy Coordinator is responsible for ensuring timely submission of Housing Assistance Payment (HAP) requests and associated Tenant Rental Assistance Certification System (TRACS) files. You will post payments of subsidy funds upon notification from the Accounting Department. Work with Operations to process corrections based on TRACS error messages or transmission reports from Contract Administrators.
  
Please note that this position offers a pay range of $14.51-$31.10 per hour based on job responsibilities and scope, geographic location, candidate’s relevant experience, and other factors. The typical work schedule will be Monday through Friday, between the hours of 8:00AM to 5:00PM.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Investigate TRACS errors and collaborate with Contract Administrators and Operations to resolve as necessary.
* Assist with teaching and training to new users or existing Rent software users with TRACS preparation and submission, as well as proper completion of certifications and error corrections, when necessary or upon request.
* Submit HAP requests and TRACS files.
* Post subsidy funds upon receipt.
* Assist sites with Enterprise Income Verification (EIV) compliance, including but not limited to processing repayment plans, running, storing, and/or investigating and resolving EIV report findings as needed.
* Monitor compliance percentage in TRACS, communicate concerns to Operations and collaborate on ways to improve the compliance percentage.
* Perform other responsibilities as assigned.

**Requirements:**  

* Associate’s degree in accounting and/or finance.
* 1-3 years of direct affordable housing subsidy work experience, specializing in Project-Based Section 8 and other affordable housing programs.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications: Excel, Word and Outlook.
* Demonstrated organizational and record keeping skills.
* Ability to exercise good judgment and apply initiative.
* Excellent customer service skills.
* Strong problem solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s degree.
* COS and/or CPO certifications.
* Prior experience in affordable housing management, either as an onsite Property Manager at a HUD subsidized property, or in a centralized subsidy billing environment.
* Knowledge of RealPage property management software.

Benefits & Perks
  
Eligible full-time U.S. employees enjoy a competitive benefits package, including:
  

* Generous paid time off, paid holidays, sick time, a floating holiday, and a day of service
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA, FSA, and dependent care savings options
* 401(k) with company match and company-paid life, AD&D, and long-term disability insurance
* Tuition reimbursement, professional development opportunities, and career growth resources
* Wellness programs, employee assistance resources, commuter benefits, and employee discount programs
* Flexible work options for eligible positions

Learn more about our benefits at https://www.winnbenefits.com.
  
  
If you are a California Resident, please see our Notice of Collection here.
  
  
It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.
  
Salary will vary based on job responsibilities and scope, geographic location, candidate’s relevant experience, and other factors.

0a82059e5a3d990ac784.title: Patient Success Specialist
0a82059e5a3d990ac784.description:
**Patient Success Specialist**
==============================

### **Are You Someone Who Takes Initiative and Gets Things Done?**

**Full-Time | In-Person | Optimal Health**

Some people wait to be told what needs to be done. Others recognize what needs attention, take ownership, and make it happen.

We're looking for the second person.

Optimal Health is a growing chiropractic and physical therapy practice seeking an outgoing, organized, and motivated individual to play an important role in our patient experience.

We're looking for someone who is:

* Naturally personable and great with people.
* Extremely organized and detail-oriented.
* Confident communicating over the phone.
* Comfortable with sales and helping people make decisions.
* Motivated by goals, accountability, and results.
* Proactive, dependable, and willing to take ownership.
* Interested in learning and growing into additional responsibilities.

If you're looking for a job where you sit behind a desk, answer a few phones, and wait for the day to end, this probably isn't for you.

But if you enjoy staying busy, connecting with people, and making things happen, keep reading.

**The Role: Owning the Patient Experience**
-------------------------------------------

Our doctors and physical therapists develop excellent treatment plans, but those plans only work when patients understand their recommendations, stay scheduled, and follow through with their care.

Your job is to help make that happen.

You'll serve as an important connection between our patients, providers, clinical team, and front office. You'll stay on top of patients who need calls, appointments, follow-ups, or additional support.

You'll recognize when someone cancels, stops attending, has questions, or hasn't followed through. Rather than waiting for someone else to address the situation, you'll take the initiative to find a solution.

**What You'll Be Responsible For:**

**Focus Area**

**Key Responsibilities**

  

Patient Relationships

Building rapport and creating a welcoming experience in person and over the phone.

  

Communication

Making daily outbound calls, answering questions, and following up with patients.

  

Patient Engagement

Helping new patients navigate their first visits and understand their treatment plans.

  

Retention & Follow-Up

Reconnecting with patients who cancel, miss appointments, or stop attending.

  

Scheduling & Coordination

Keeping patients appropriately scheduled and coordinating chiropractic and PT care.

  

Problem Solving

Helping patients navigate scheduling, financial, and logistical concerns.

  

Team Communication

Reinforcing provider recommendations and recognizing when questions need to go back to a doctor.

  

Organization

Tracking conversations, follow-ups, and outstanding responsibilities so nothing gets overlooked.

There will be administrative work, phone calls, and scheduling, but those are only tools of the position.

The bigger responsibility is making sure patients feel supported, understand their care, and stay engaged throughout their experience.

**Who We're Looking For**
-------------------------

Your personality and work ethic matter just as much as your resume.

**You're great with people.** You enjoy meeting new people, starting conversations, remembering names, and making others feel comfortable.

**You're confident on the phone.** You don't avoid conversations or rely on text messages. You're comfortable reaching out to new people and consistently following up.

**You understand sales.** We're not looking for pushy sales tactics. We want someone who listens, asks thoughtful questions, communicates value, and confidently helps people make decisions.

**You're highly organized.** If you tell someone you'll call Tuesday, you call Tuesday. You keep track of responsibilities and don't need constant reminders.

**You're motivated by results.** You enjoy working toward goals, measuring progress, and being held accountable. You see feedback as an opportunity to improve.

**You take ownership.** When something becomes your responsibility, you see it through. You don't just report what you attempted; you understand the situation, communicate what happened, and identify the next step.

We're building detailed training systems for patient communication, follow-up, sales, and treatment plan retention. We'll teach you our processes, but we expect you to be coachable, engaged, and willing to continuously improve.

**No Healthcare Experience? No Problem!**
-----------------------------------------

We're open to candidates from a variety of professional backgrounds.

We can teach you about chiropractic, physical therapy, our services, and how patients move through their care. What's harder to teach is confidence, initiative, curiosity, organization, and the ability to connect with people.

You might come from:

* Sales or business development
* Hospitality or customer service
* Fitness, sports, or wellness
* Recruiting or account management
* Retail
* Healthcare
* Athletics or leadership

**Recent college graduates are absolutely encouraged to apply!**

If you're early in your career but motivated, organized, personable, and eager to learn, we'd love to hear from you.

**Why Optimal Health?**
-----------------------

We're not building an average healthcare office.

Optimal Health brings chiropractic, physical therapy, rehabilitation, and additional treatment options together under one roof. Our providers work as a team to help patients move better, feel better, and stay active.

We're busy, growing, and continuously improving our team and systems.

This position offers the opportunity to:

* Work directly with doctors, therapists, clinical staff, and leadership.
* Take ownership of an important part of the patient experience.
* Develop skills in healthcare, communication, sales, and operations.
* Contribute ideas and help improve how the practice functions.
* Grow into additional responsibilities as the practice expands.

You won't simply be another employee sitting at the front desk. You'll become an important part of how our practice operates and grows.

**Schedule & Compensation**
---------------------------

**Employment Details**

**Information**

  

Position

Patient Experience & Engagement Specialist

  

Employment Type

Full-Time

  

Work Environment

In-Person

  

Compensation

Competitive hourly pay based on experience, ability, and fit

  

Additional Earnings

Performance-based bonuses after successful training and demonstrated competency

**Schedule Expectations:**

Our patient hours include early mornings and evenings, so some flexibility is required.

Certain shifts may extend until approximately 6:00–7:00 PM, but you will not work late every night. Expect a combination of earlier and later shifts based on patient volume and team coverage.

We believe strong performance should create greater opportunities for growth and additional compensation.

**Think You're the Right Person?**
----------------------------------

We don't want another generic resume from someone applying to 50 different jobs.

We want to see how you think, communicate, and approach new challenges.

That's why we're including a short application exercise.

### **The Optimal Health Challenge**

**1. Send Us Your Resume**

Submit your current resume outlining your education, experience, and relevant skills.

**2. Spend 10 Minutes Learning About Us**

Visit **www.optimalhealth.fit** and choose one treatment, technique, or service we offer that you weren't previously familiar with.

In 150 words or less, tell us:

* What is it?
* How would you explain it in simple language to a patient who was nervous or confused?
* Why did you choose that particular service?

**Don't copy our website.** We want to see how YOU communicate and explain new information.

**3. Prove You Read Everything**

At the very bottom of your application, include this exact sentence:

**"I read the whole thing."**

If it's missing, your application won't move forward.

**One Last Thing...**
---------------------

After reading this job description, did you find yourself thinking:

*"I'd crush this."*

Good. That's the kind of person we want to meet.

Complete the challenge and send your resume and responses to:

**jess@optimalhealth.fit**

If we think you could be a great fit, we'll reach out to discuss next steps.

We're looking forward to hearing from you!

About Us:

We specialize in providing non-core, mission critical facilities maintenance and management services to large organizations with geographically dispersed properties in various industries such as retail, restaurants, banking, telecommunications, and others with multi-location business operations.

Job Summary:

USM is looking for multiple temporary/part time "on demand" Customer Service Representatives to coordinate the delivery of snow removal services for USM’s national client base. This position assists our account teams with the front end and clerical tasks related to scheduling, notifying and validating the vendors in our network that are providing snow and ice remediation services to our various clients. Representatives respond to customer service requests electronically and by phone to ensure that services provided meet or exceed client and USM’s expectations.

**These roles are ideal for:**

* Those looking to earn extra money
* Those available only part time, due to other obligations
* College students
* Stay-at-home parents with daytime availability

**Schedules:**

* You provide your availability upon hire and will be scheduled as needed within those hours. You can change your availability at any time.
* Additional requests for staff may be sent if there are additional shifts that need coverage (due to new snow events etc).
* The work schedules for each week will vary significantly along with the snowfall patterns throughout the country. While we cannot guarantee a minimum number of hours, the ability to change your availability from week to week gives you the freedom to be flexible with your schedule.
* These roles are anticipated to be needed from December 2025 to April 2026

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

* Take incoming calls from customers and suppliers and route them to the appropriate account team member
* Advanced work order triage and troubleshooting via email, telephone or 3rd party communications
* Act as a trusted resource for customers and suppliers
* Prepare customer invoices
* Other tasks as required

Qualifications:

* Prior experience working in a high volume, fast paced customer service role. Call center experience preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to problem solve.
* Proven ability to multitask and prioritize.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Experience in the trades, such as HVAC, Floor Care, Electrical, Plumbing, Roofing, Landscaping or building repair and maintenance a plus
* Previous experience working with a work order management system a plus
* Bi-lingual English/Spanish skills a plus

Work hours for this position are subject to change; ample notice will be provided prior to any schedule changes. While we will work to try and accommodate your availability we are not able to guarantee any certain number of hours per week. The more flexibility that you offer, the more that there will be a chance for hours.

**We offer our "On Demand" seasonal employees:**

* A competitive salary
* Opportunity to work a flexible schedule (the more hours that you are available, the more opportunities that there may be to work)
* Proven performers may be able to return next season in the same or similar role. Some of our part time team members have been working for us for several years.

Whether you are looking for some extra spending money for the holidays and beyond, or to supplement your income, our part time team might be right for you.

Physical Demands:

Must be able to remain in a stationary position. Constantly operates a computer, copy machine and printer

Work Environment:

Must have flexibility and adaptability in work schedule in order to serve a broad base of clients in multiple time zones with locations operations seven days a week. Typical work schedule would be Monday - Friday 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, or 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM during the core landscaping season (April through October). Earlier/later shifts, which may include weekends, are required during the snow season (November through March).

Promotes a positive safety culture by fully complying with all safety policies and procedures, and applicable federal, states and local regulations.

Equal Opportunity Employer: As a leading provider of mechanical and electrical construction, facilities services, and energy infrastructure, we offer employees a competitive salary and benefits package and we are always looking for individuals with the talent and skills required to contribute to our continued growth and success. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled. Affirmative Action Policy:

Please review our Affirmative Action Policy.

53a827764fe87d8701ca.description:
**About Mindset Care, Inc.**

**Mindset was founded to create a better experience for those with a mental illness and their caregivers in applying for Social Security Disability benefits.**  
  
**Our team of Social Security Disability lawyers and representatives has helped thousands of individuals through the arduous process of obtaining Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and/or Supplemental Security income (SSI) through the Social Security Administration.**

Mindset is seeking an empathetic, detail-oriented SSD Eligibility Specialist to serve as a trusted first point of contact for prospective clients. This role conducts structured phone assessments, gathers sensitive medical and employment information, explains the Social Security Disability (SSD) intake and application process—including SSI and SSDI—and maintains complete, accurate records. The ideal candidate combines direct SSD or disability-benefits experience with strong client service, sound judgment, organization, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

Due to this being a remote role, you’ll need a reliable internet connection with speeds of at least 100 Mbps download and 30 Mbps upload, a comfortable place to work, and a backup plan for occasional internet outages. We will provide your MacBook as well as a headset, keyboard, and monitor as needed. You will be responsible for maintaining a setup that supports a productive workday. During scheduled working hours, employees must be able to perform the position’s essential duties and meet its attendance, availability, productivity, confidentiality, and performance expectations, subject to approved leave, reasonable accommodations, and applicable law.

Job Responsibilities:

* Conduct structured telephone intake and eligibility assessments to understand each client’s medical, employment, and service needs.
* Collect, verify, and document sensitive client information accurately, completely, and confidentially.
* Explain Mindset’s services and next steps in clear, compassionate language.
* Support clients who may be distressed, overwhelmed, or unfamiliar with the SSI/SSDI process.
* Manage inbound and outbound calls, follow-up tasks, and multiple priorities while meeting quality and productivity expectations.
* Maintain accurate client records in case management, CRM, or related systems.
* Coordinate with case management and other internal teams to ensure a smooth client handoff.
* Follow privacy, security, and documentation requirements.
* Participate in coaching, training, quality review, and team meetings.
* Apply critical thinking to analyze intake information, assess the reported severity of a claimant’s conditions and their impact on daily functioning and ability to work, and identify appropriate follow-up questions.
* All other duties as assigned by the leadership team.

Qualifications:

* Demonstrated experience in intake, phone-based customer service, client support, healthcare, public benefits, case support, or a comparable role.
* Direct experience supporting Social Security Disability (SSD) claims—including SSI and SSDI intake, eligibility screening, medical and work history collection, and application preparation.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and a consistent record of accurate documentation.
* Empathy, professionalism, and sound judgment when discussing sensitive medical and financial circumstances.
* Ability to organize follow-up work, multitask, and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to connect medical information to reported functional limitations, identify gaps or inconsistencies, ask appropriate follow-up questions, and explain complex processes in plain language.
* Comfort working independently and reliably in a remote environment.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and the ability to learn new systems.
* Reliable internet connection for remote work.
* High school diploma or equivalent, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with case management, client advocacy, benefits navigation, or eligibility screening.
* Experience managing a high volume of inbound and outbound client calls.
* Experience using CRM, case-management, EHR, virtual phone, or online scheduling systems.
* Spanish-language proficiency is helpful but not required.
* A college degree is not required; relevant experience and demonstrated capability are valued.

What Success Looks Like:

* Clients feel heard, respected, and confident about their next steps.
* Intake records are complete, accurate, and submitted on time.
* Complex SSD, SSI, and SSDI processes are explained clearly and consistently.
* Follow-up tasks are managed reliably without sacrificing quality.

18 - 25 USD per hour(Remote (United States))

a38803557b9187fb35e7.title: Implementation Support Specialist
a38803557b9187fb35e7.description:
**About Empower Community Care**
--------------------------------

Empower Community Care is a family of mission-driven organizations delivering evidence-based behavioral health, child welfare, and community care programs and services. Our portfolio includes BSFT, Carey Group, Evidence-Based Associates (EBA), FFT LLC, MST Services, Orbis, and The Incredible Years — each advancing outcomes for children, families, and the communities we serve.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Implementation Support Specialist provides cross-model implementation, operational, and customer success support for Functional Family Therapy (FFT), Multisystemic Therapy (MST), and Brief Strategic Family Therapy (BSFT). This position leads assigned provider organizations through onboarding and launch and continues to provide support alongside clinical model staff to ensure sustainability, fidelity, and customer success.  
The Specialist coordinates implementation plans, workforce and referral readiness, technical assistance, project milestones, program monitoring, and partner relationships. The position works collaboratively with EBP model teams, which retain responsibility for model-specific clinical consultation, fidelity coaching, certification, and clinical decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Onboarding and Launch**

* **Provider Onboarding:** Lead assigned providers through onboarding, workforce readiness, launch preparation, and early operations for FFT, MST, and BSFT.
* **Planning and Project Management:** Develop and maintain implementation roadmaps, timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and launch-readiness documentation, and coordinate project management and technical assistance to keep launches on time, in scope, and responsive to emerging barriers.
* **Workforce Planning:** Collaborate with recruiting and provider leadership to support staffing plans, candidate sourcing needs, role readiness, and workforce preparation for launch.
* **Readiness Assessment:** Assess readiness related to leadership, staffing, training, service capacity, operational infrastructure, and stakeholder engagement.
* **Referral and Access:** Design and strengthen referral and access processes so appropriate populations can reach available program capacity.
* **Organizational Change:** Support operational and organizational change required to adopt new practices and reduce implementation drift.
* **Launch Coordination:** Coordinate launch logistics with EBP clinical technical assistance teams while maintaining clear boundaries between operational implementation support and model-specific clinical responsibilities.
* **Documentation and Escalation:** Document decisions, risks, action items, and progress; promptly elevate barriers requiring leadership or model-specific expertise.

### **Sustainability and Customer Success**

* **Partner Relationships:** Maintain ongoing relationships with assigned provider organizations through proactive check-ins, account health monitoring, responsive support, and escalation management.
* **Program Monitoring:** Monitor staffing stability, referrals, caseloads, utilization, access, financial sustainability, fidelity indicators, outcomes, and other applicable measures, and identify early warning signals related to vacancies, turnover, capacity, referral volume, access barriers, reimbursement, budget pressures, or renewal risk.
* **Risk Response:** Lead the operational response to implementation risks and coordinate joint problem-solving with EBP clinical leadership when clinical or fidelity action is required, including workforce retention, referral pathway troubleshooting, implementation improvement plans, and other actions that strengthen program viability.
* **Renewal and Expansion:** Coordinate renewal and expansion support, identify opportunities to connect partners with other appropriate organizational offerings, and promote partner satisfaction, retention, high-quality service delivery, and long-term program sustainability.
* **Reporting and Records:** Prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, and status updates that communicate implementation progress, account health, risks, and outcomes; maintain accurate records and provide regular updates to the Director of EBP Implementation.

### **Cross-Functional Responsibilities**

* **Stakeholder Relationships:** Build collaborative relationships with provider leaders, supervisors, clinicians, funders, referral sources, and community stakeholders while maintaining clear expectations and shared accountability.
* **Facilitation and Training:** Facilitate provider and stakeholder training and/or meetings, including provider implementation training on best practices, timelines, and expectations for successful implementation, with agenda development, documentation, decision-making, and follow-up.
* **Data-Informed Decisions:** Use data to guide implementation decisions, monitor readiness and program health, and support continuous quality improvement.
* **Portfolio Management:** Manage multiple programs, priorities, deadlines, and special projects across the EBP portfolio, and participate in EBP initiatives as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in behavioral health, social work, psychology, public health, human services, business, project management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* **Experience:** At least three (3) years of relevant experience in program implementation, project management, provider support, customer success, behavioral health, or human services, including demonstrated experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, monitoring program performance, and supporting implementation from launch through sustainability.
* **Core Skills:** Strong implementation, project coordination, organization, and time-management skills; excellent written, verbal, facilitation, presentation, and relationship-management skills.
* **Change and Data Skills:** Ability to support organizational change, resolve operational barriers, and maintain accountability through a collaborative approach; ability to interpret program and account-health data, identify risks, and translate findings into action.
* **Judgment and Independence:** Sound judgment regarding when to act directly and when to engage clinical, model-specific, funding, recruiting, or leadership partners; ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and provide reliable follow-through.
* **Technology:** Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
* **Work Requirements:** Must be legally authorized to work in the United States, reside in the United States, work Eastern Time business hours, and be able to travel up to 50% of the time.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**
---------------------------------

* **Advanced Degree:** Master’s degree in one of the fields above or a related field.
* **EBP Experience:** Experience with evidence-based or evidence-informed programs, including FFT, MST, BSFT, or another structured evidence-based practice.
* **Subject Knowledge:** Knowledge of evidence-based practices, behavioral health, human services, customer success, or implementation science.

**Additional Requirements**
---------------------------

* **Background Check:** Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable law and Empower’s standard hiring practices.
* **Confidentiality:** This role may involve exposure to confidential organizational, financial, and/or clinical program information. The employee must maintain strict confidentiality and comply with Empower’s internal data governance and confidentiality policies.
* **Work Environment:** This is a remote, computer-based position requiring prolonged periods of sitting and extended use of a computer, keyboard, and video-conferencing tools, along with travel of up to approximately 50% of the time for in-person provider onboarding, meetings, leadership offsites, or site visits. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the ADA.
* **Other Duties:** This job description reflects the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

$75,000 – $90,000 per year  
Annual base salary; placement within the range is based on experience, skills, and internal equity.

**Benefits**
------------

*Empower Community Care offers a competitive total-rewards package, which includes medical, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings; paid time off and holidays; and life insurance.*

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Empower Community Care is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

d610b4d111c183ae5578.title: Commander Coordinator
d610b4d111c183ae5578.description:
### **Company Introduction:**

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that's redefining how the world's most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America's best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

### **Own Driver Engagement in Your Region**

The Commander Coordinator is the person who makes sure Airspace's driver network in a region runs well day to day. Where the Regional Network Manager owns the complete supply picture for the region — strategy, agent partners, and escalation — the Commander Coordinator owns the direct, ongoing relationship with every Commander and Copilot driver in that region: keeping Tier 1 drivers engaged, Tier 2 drivers progressing, and Tier 3 drivers identified and resolved before they affect service.

This is a support role to the Regional Network Manager, not a standalone strategy seat. You are the direct line to drivers — the person they know, trust, and call — and the person your Regional NM depends on to know the true state of the driver pool in the region at any given time.

Like agent support, driver support is a tiered model — attention scales with where a driver sits in the network rather than spreading evenly across the whole population. Tier 1 drivers get high-touch, relationship-driven attention. Tier 2 gets consistent, standard engagement and onboarding support. Tier 3 gets focused attention aimed at surfacing issues early and, once authorized, executing deactivation cleanly. Getting that allocation right is the core judgment call in this role.

### 

### **What You'll Do**

**Tier 1 Drivers (High performers)**

* Provide high-touch support to Tier 1 Commander and Copilot drivers, including regular check-ins to maintain engagement, address concerns, and reinforce performance standards
* Serve as the primary point of contact for Tier 1 drivers in your region

**Tier 2 Drivers (General population & new drivers)**

* Support the general driver population and new drivers through onboarding, ramp guidance, and routine engagement — helping drivers build familiarity with Airspace standards and expectations early
* Monitor Tier 2 performance through automated reporting, flagging drivers trending toward Tier 3 before issues escalate

**Tier 3 Drivers (Performance and conduct — managed out)**

* Identify and surface Tier 3 drivers — those whose behavior, reliability, or conduct warrants removal from the network — using automated reporting and case data
* Execute deactivation motions once authorized by the Regional Network Manager, managing the workflow through Salesforce case management

**General**

* Manage the driver case queue in Salesforce, triaging and routing escalations and maintaining accurate records for your region
* Partner with the Network Trainer to ensure onboarding and ongoing training content is being actioned by drivers in your region, flagging completion gaps by tier
* Support your Regional Network Manager with regional context and data, escalating issues with enough detail to enable a fast decision

**Partner Across the Network Organization**

* Work closely with your Regional Network Manager, who owns the complete supply picture for the region and is your escalation point for anything that exceeds your authority
* Partner with the Driver Recruiter to support onboarding as new drivers activate in your region
* Rely on automated performance reporting — built and maintained by the Lead, US Network Strategy & Operations — to monitor driver tiers, flagging anomalies or field-level context back through your Regional NM
* Coordinate with Network Quality & Compliance on documentation standards during periodic audits

  

### **Requirements**

* At least 1-3+ years of experience in driver or contractor engagement, dispatch, account management, or another customer/partner-facing operational role — experience in logistics, transportation, or a gig/contractor network environment is strongly preferred
* Comfortable managing a caseload of drivers with different needs across tiers — high-touch relationship management for top performers, consistent standard engagement for the general population, and clear, unemotional documentation for drivers being managed out
* Strong documentation habits; comfortable owning a case queue in Salesforce or a comparable CRM
* Clear, empathetic communicator, comfortable delivering both positive engagement and difficult feedback
* Based within, or willing to be based within, your assigned region (Pacific Time zone preferred); comfortable with regular local travel to meet drivers in person

### **Success Metrics**

**2026**

Tier 1 drivers in your region are engaged and retained at a high rate. Tier 2 drivers, including new drivers, are onboarding smoothly and building familiarity with Airspace standards. Tier 3 drivers are identified early and resolved through a clean, well-documented process once authorized. The case queue is current with no aging escalations, and your Regional NM has clear, timely visibility into the state of the driver pool.

**2027**

Your region shows measurable improvement in Tier 1 share of active drivers and in driver retention. Onboarding-to-first-segment time for new drivers is trending down. Your Regional NM relies on your judgment on escalations without needing to double-check the underlying work.

  

### **Your First 90 Days**

Get to know the drivers in your region — who they are, where they sit in the tier structure, and what's currently open in the case queue. Build a working relationship with your Regional Network Manager and establish a clear operating cadence together. Learn the automated reporting tools well enough to trust what they're telling you and to know when field context should override them.

### **Your First 180 Days**

Your regional driver engagement cadence is running consistently across all three tiers. The case queue is clean and current. Your Regional NM sees you as a reliable source of ground truth on the driver pool, and new drivers activating in your region are onboarding smoothly with your support.

At the University of Phoenix, we are committed to the future of work by providing a fully remote, work-from-home environment. This strategy enables us to attract top talent nationwide. Ideally, would you like this position to be with an organization that makes a positive contribution to the world? If so…we would love to hear from you!

  
  

**About Us**

University of Phoenix is a leading higher education institution founded in 1976 by Dr. John Sperling. Our mission is to improve the lives of our students, their families and future generations through higher education. Our values (which hopefully you share) are: Brave. Honest. Focused.

  

Our University values and embraces all team members and their unique perspectives. We fundamentally believe in fostering an environment which deeply respects, celebrates, and actively encourages a diverse workforce. We are committed to hiring – and learning from – those who share our passion to help others achieve their educational aspirations.

  

We offer excellent benefits, an effective recognition program, and outstanding learning and development tools, including tuition vouchers for employees and their qualified family members.

**About the Position**

Student Support Specialists (Academic Counselors) work in a fast-paced, home-based virtual office environment to provide academic advisement, coaching, and customer service to students throughout the student lifecycle. Student Support Specialists are available throughout their assigned shift to accept/make student calls and complete work items delivered based on system priority. Student Support Specialists (Academic Counselors) use the University’s coaching model to partner with students, build connections, create action plans, motivate, and resolve student issues. Individuals in this role are the bridge for the student and University administration, ensuring students have access to information, policies, procedures, and requirements they need to make informed decisions. Student Support Specialists are natural problem solvers, on many occasions dealing with student issues that require research, de-escalation, and critical thinking. Individuals in this role must be available throughout their assigned shift to accept/make student calls and complete work items delivered based on system priority.

  
  

IMPORTANT:

You must reside in one of the following states: AZ, ID, NV, NM, MT, UT, TX, WY. You must have fully completed a bachelor's degree prior to applying. This position is expected to start on February 1, 2027.

  
  

About You:

* You are known for your ability to connect with people, building trusting relationships, and like to be someone others can count on.

* You thrive in an environment that is supportive with continuous feedback so you can be extremely helpful to those you connect with.

* You are a careful, analytical, thoughtful decision-maker and you enjoy having clear expectations and an opportunity to develop real expertise in your work.

* You have excellent written and interpersonal communication skills and exceptional organizational skills.

* You are known for being dependable, consistent, and methodical.

  

\*You have fully completed and conferred a bachelor's degree prior to applying\*

  
  

Schedule:

This position is required to start on February 1, 2027.

  
  

* Schedule during the first three months of onboarding is Monday - Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm AZ Standard Time. The first 6 weeks of employment are considered the "training period". Attendance is mandatory during the training period for success in this job.

* After the training period, your schedule will be either 9:00am - 6:00pm or 10:00am - 7:00pm (in your time zone), as determined by the needs of your department.

**What You’ll Do:**

  

1. Work full-time shift as scheduled to ensure high-quality service and availability for assigned student population, and to support department service levels and performance goals.

2. Engage in meaningful interactions and develop rapport across a diverse population of students to facilitate their academic progression.

3. Engage in meaningful interactions and develop rapport across a diverse population of students to facilitate their academic progression.

4. Assess student needs using all available tools, including the University’s coaching model and resources, to plan interventions to support student progression.

5. Act as a subject matter expert for students with respect to degree options, program requirements and graduation. Provide students with accurate, complete, and timely information on University policies and procedures.

6. Coordinate with students on all credit options to develop an academic plan that is best suited to their needs and career goals while taking into consideration how to minimize cost and time to graduation.

7. Establish and maintain professional working relationships across internal departments to ensure students benefit from a variety of professional knowledge and perspectives.

8. Recommend changes, share student and other feedback on ways to continuously improve the student experience.

9. Perform other duties as assigned or apparent.

Additional Primary Accountabilities for Academic Counselors not on Written team:

1. Complete an average of at least 3-4 Items Per Hour to include receiving and making phone calls and completing work items delivered systematically.

2. Perform and manage multiple tasks efficiently and effectively to maximize availability for incoming student calls while meeting department standards for productivity and quality.

Additional Primary Accountabilities for Academic Counselors on Written team:

1. Complete an average of at least 7-8 Activities Per Hour to include receiving and responding to chats, emails, and SMS work that is delivered systematically.

2. Perform and manage multiple tasks efficiently and effectively to maximize availability for incoming student inquiries while meeting department standards for productivity and quality.

3. Receive and make phone calls and complete work items delivered systematically per business need.

NOTE: The Primary Accountabilities above are intended to describe the general content and requirements of the position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. Incumbents may perform all or most of the Primary Accountabilities listed above. Specific goals or responsibilities will be documented in incumbents’ performance objectives as outlined by the incumbents’ immediate manager.

Job Supervisory Responsibilities

None

**MINIMUM EDUCATION AND RELATED WORK EXPERIENCE**:

* Bachelor’s Degree

**ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS**:

* Computer proficient with an ability to learn and navigate various complex proprietary software applications.

* Experience with CRMs, Microsoft applications, video conferencing

* General knowledge of the higher education industry

* General knowledge of fields of study, such as business, education, technology, counseling and/or nursing

* Strong analytical skills to assess and evaluate students’ needs and determine appropriate courses of action.

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to engage and influence students accurately and effectively convey UOPX information.

* Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a team environment or independently.

#LI-Remote

939c82f68d616df83910.title: HR Coordinator
939c82f68d616df83910.description:
Be part of something bigger at Minaris — where every role contributes to creating hope for patients around the world. As a global leader in cell and gene therapy development, manufacturing, and testing, we turn breakthrough science into real-world treatments that change lives. Our team of over 1,000 experts across North America, Europe, and Asia has helped bring transformative therapies to market.
  
  
At Minaris, you’ll join a purpose-driven community focused on innovation, collaboration, and patient impact. Whether you’re in the lab, in the cleanroom, or behind the scenes, your work will directly support life-saving therapies and make a lasting difference. If you're passionate about advancing cutting-edge science and believe in the potential of cell and gene therapies, we invite you to help shape the future of medicine—one patient at a time.
  
  
Position Summary
  
TEMPORARY ROLE INITIALLY
  
The HR Coordinator supports the HR Operations function by providing high-quality administrative, transactional, and systems support to ensure efficient and compliant delivery of HR services across the organization. This role plays a critical part in maintaining data integrity within HR systems, processing employee lifecycle transactions, coordinating documentation, and supporting standardized HR processes. The HR Coordinator serves as a key operational resource, helping ensure consistency, accuracy, and responsiveness in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
  
  
Working closely with HR Operations and HR Business Partners (HRBPs), the HR Coordinator helps manage onboarding and offboarding logistics, job changes, employee records, reporting, compliance tracking, and general HR inquiries. This role is especially important in supporting ongoing HR process improvements and system enhancements, helping to stabilize daily operations while contributing to increased efficiency and service excellence. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, systems-savvy, and capable of managing multiple priorities with professionalism and discretion.
  
  
Essential Functions and Responsibilities
  
HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Support
  

* Process and track employee lifecycle transactions including new hires, onboarding, internal transfers, promotions, compensation changes, and terminations.
* Ensure timely and accurate data entry and maintenance within the HRIS and other HR systems.
* Maintain employee personnel files and ensure documentation is complete, organized, and compliant with company policies and legal requirements.
* Support onboarding and offboarding logistics, including preparation of documentation, system access coordination, and checklist tracking.
* Generate routine HR reports (e.g., headcount, turnover, new hire status) and support ad hoc reporting requests.

HR Systems & Process Administration
  

* Maintain high standards of data integrity across HR systems; identify discrepancies and resolve errors proactively.
* Assist with HR systems updates, testing, and process improvements during system implementations or enhancements.
* Support documentation and standardization of HR processes and workflows.

Compliance & Risk Mitigation
  

* Track and manage required compliance documentation (e.g., I-9s, policy acknowledgments, certifications, required notices).
* Assist with internal audits and compliance reviews by preparing documentation and reports.
* Ensure confidentiality and proper handling of sensitive employee information.

HR Support
  

* Provide administrative support to HR, including scheduling meetings, preparing documentation templates, maintaining org charts, and tracking action items.
* Assist with coordination of performance management cycles, engagement surveys, and other HR programs.

Employee & Manager Support
  

* Serve as a point of contact for general HR inquiries; respond or triage questions appropriately.
* Provide professional, timely, and customer-focused support to employees and managers.
* Escalate complex or sensitive matters to appropriate HR team members.

Operational Excellence
  

* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within HR Operations.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance employee experience.
* Support special projects and other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
  

* Understanding of HR compliance requirements and confidentiality standards related to employee records.
* Basic knowledge of HRIS systems and data management best practices.
* Familiarity with onboarding, offboarding, and personnel documentation processes.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* High attention to detail and accuracy in data entry, documentation, and reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook); ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with a professional and service-oriented approach.
* Strong administrative and coordination skills, including scheduling and tracking deliverables.
* Analytical skills to identify data discrepancies and support reporting needs.
* Problem-solving skills with the ability to escalate issues appropriately.

Education and Experience
  

* Associate’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field required; Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* In lieu of a degree, equivalent combination of education and relevant administrative or HR experience may be considered.
* HR certification (e.g., SHRM-CP, PHR) is a plus but not required.

Quality Requirements
  

* Ensure compliance with all FDA and Worldwide Quality & Compliance regulations in all aspects of your work.
* Adhere to established procedures and protocols, prioritize continuous training and skill development, and uphold the highest standards of data integrity to ensure accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.

Disclaimer
  
The above information in this description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It does not contain nor is it intended to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
  
  
The estimated base salary range for each open position based in the United States of America is included for all our current openings. Should the level or location of the role change during the hiring process, the applicable base pay range may be updated accordingly. Compensation decisions are dependent on several factors including, but not limited to, an individual’s qualifications, location where the role is to be performed, internal equity, and alignment with market data. Additionally, all employees are eligible for one of our variable cash programs (bonus or commission) as part of the compensation package. Minaris Advanced Therapies employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical insurance, vision insurance, dental insurance, 401(k), paid time off, tuition assistance, and more.

09bb8585b26ca985a93e.description:
ePathUSA is looking for a Recruitment Lead responsible for driving full-cycle recruitment efforts and supporting the organization's talent acquisition strategy. This role serves as a recruiting subject matter expert, partnering with hiring managers to attract, evaluate, and hire top talent while ensuring a positive candidate experience. The Lead Recruiter provides guidance on recruiting best practices, helps improve hiring processes, and plays a key role in meeting the company's workforce planning and growth objectives.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic recruiting consultation, including talent assessment, candidate engagement, offer development, and negotiation strategies.
* Lead sourcing, screening, and selection of candidates supporting government, state, and commercial client hiring needs.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and external clients while influencing hiring decisions and recruitment strategies.
* Ensure compliance with EEO, OFCCP, immigration, state employment, and client-specific hiring requirements.
* Provide day-to-day leadership and direction to sourcers and recruiting coordinators.
* Conduct labor market and talent research to support recruiting strategies.
* Partner with hiring managers to develop workforce plans, hiring strategies, screening criteria, and interview processes.
* Source, screen, interview, and evaluate candidates throughout the full recruitment lifecycle.
* Lead, mentor, and develop recruiters, sourcers, and recruiting coordinators through coaching and performance feedback.
* Monitor and report on recruiting metrics and hiring outcomes.
* Engage and influence clients and hiring managers regarding market conditions, talent availability, and hiring expectations.
* Utilize ATS and recruitment technologies to improve recruiting effectiveness and efficiency.
* Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer negotiation, and hiring.
* Experience utilizing and optimizing Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment technologies.
* Experience managing high-volume recruitment efforts across multiple requisitions and business lines.
* Demonstrated ability to attract and successfully close top talent in competitive labor markets.
* Working knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws affecting recruiting and hiring practices.
* Experience partnering with hiring managers and stakeholders to develop recruiting strategies.

**Desired Qualifications**

* 6-8 years of recruiting experience, preferably in healthcare, technology, staffing, or government contracting environments.
* Working knowledge of OFCCP regulations and affirmative action requirements.
* Experience with Zoho Recruit and/or Paycom.
* Experience mentoring recruiters, sourcers, or recruiting coordinators.
* Strong candidate assessment and interviewing skills.
* Experience recruiting and building relationships with candidates from diverse backgrounds and professional experiences.
* Experience using recruiting metrics and reporting to drive hiring decisions.

Part-Time Remote Psychiatric Practice Administrative Coordinator

**Insight NP in Psychiatry, PLLC | Remote | Part-Time | 20 Hours per Week**

**Compensation: $25–$35 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.**

Overview

Insight NP in Psychiatry, PLLC is a New York-based outpatient psychiatric practice seeking an experienced, organized, and compassionate Administrative Coordinator to support day-to-day practice operations.

Our practice provides psychiatric medication management and mental health care to adults, primarily through telehealth, with an emphasis on patient-centered, LGBTQ+ affirming care.

We are seeking a candidate with at least five years of administrative experience in a psychiatric, or behavioral health practice, preferably in an outpatient mental health setting. The ideal candidate is comfortable independently managing patient communications, scheduling, insurance coordination, and administrative workflows while maintaining a high standard of professionalism, empathy, and attention to detail.

This is a fully remote, part-time position requiring approximately 20 hours per week. We are looking for someone who is proactive, dependable, detail-oriented, and capable of managing responsibilities independently while collaborating effectively with clinical providers and other administrative team members.

Duties and Responsibilities

* Manage patient scheduling, appointment confirmations, cancellations, and rescheduling.
* Respond professionally and compassionately to patient phone calls, emails, and portal messages.

f2ee9c54596d284f12b0.description:
**About the team**
------------------

Buying, selling and financing homes is a complicated process with uncertain timelines. The Connections team is passionate about changing that. We interact and support movers to improve their experience, tailoring our approach to meet each customer where they are at in the process. Our team is responsible for delivering an outstanding consumer experience and tapping into our expertise to get every customer moving in unlocking their next chapter. We are central to the B2C mission of integrating offerings across the Zillow platform, making it easier for customers to buy and sell their homes.

**About the role**
------------------

Are you a high-energy team-player with excellent organization and interpersonal skills? Are you motivated to achieve and exceed monthly targets on a consistent basis while providing outstanding service? The Connections Specialist is a highly sociable individual who plays an instrumental role in revolutionizing the way consumers connect with Zillow products and Real Estate professionals. You will be engaged in our dynamic environment and expected to live Zillow Group’s Core Values. If you are ready to work hard, learn, and be challenged to grow and improve- we look forward to talking with you soon.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Interact directly with customers to discover their needs and offer solutions using Zillow’s products and services
* Get customers connected to the right Zillow products and professionals through an understanding of real estate and a dedication to crafting an outstanding customer experience
* Collaborate with peers and leadership to build an environment rooted in trust, self-discipline, and friendly competition to achieve goals together
* Drive accountability for yourself and your team through proactive engagement with your peers and active involvement in team discussions and initiatives
* Ensure compliance to Zillow Group and real estate norms, policies, and regulations to the highest degree
* Respond to changes in the business with agility and skill at navigating ambiguity

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $16.30 - $24.50 hourly. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $15.50 - $23.30 hourly. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Confident working in a high energy, customer facing, demand generation workflow
* Strong communication skills through email, phone, text, and personal interaction
* Ability to thrive in a team environment, excited to share new insights to help the team grow and succeed
* Internally motivated to achieve results, and you pride yourself on continuous improvement in your work
* Believe in the principle that crafting strong rapport with customers and colleagues alike is essential to long-term success
* Understand that process matters, and follow SOPs to ensure consistency in the customer experience
Familiarity with real estate industry a plus  

  

**Required Experience:**

* 2+ years experience in account management, customer service, demand generation or an inbound/outbound sales role with a proven track record of goal achievement and the ability to deliver an excellent customer experience
* Quick and flexible learner, willing and able to adapt rapidly to change
* Must be comfortable conducting both inbound and outbound consultative sales calls; skilled in discovery, handling initial reluctance, and objection handling.
* Ability to storytell - to be engaging and authentic with customers and drive trust in Zillow products
* Must possess great interpersonal skills; knowing how to actively listen and use objections as a space to ask more questions
* Must possess excellent presentation skills, providing recommendations to customers that meet their needs
* Excellent problem-solving skills with a technical ability to listen and hear opportunities that lead to success for our customers
* Willing to work flexible schedules that include early mornings, late nights, weekends and holidays
* Must have experience with web-based products, MS Office and Google Suite

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

  

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

  

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

  

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.*

  

*Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.*

  

*Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation.
