11de3021b60b2dadbc27.title: Rental Manager
11de3021b60b2dadbc27.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Rental Manager leads the Rental department and is responsible for both growing rental revenue and running day-to-day rental operations. The role entails a combination of developing customer accounts, supporting sales account managers seeking new rental business, and generating in-house sales growth with hands-on oversight of rental contracts, equipment check-out and check-in, and fleet utilization. The Rental Manager supervises Rental employees, resolves escalated customer issues, and works closely with the Sales and Repair teams to deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage entry-level employees.
* Train new employees on the company policies, procedures, and best practices.
* Organize and oversee the schedules and work of assigned employees.
* Conduct performance evaluations that are timely and constructive.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

***Rental Sales & Account Growth***

* Drive rental revenue growth by supporting and coordinating with rental customers to keep them engaged, retained, and growing.
* Conduct needs assessments with customers and recommend appropriate equipment, rental terms, and add-on services for each job.
* Prepare rental quotes and proposals, and contribute to rental rate structures, pricing, and contract negotiations.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for key rental customers, ensuring high satisfaction and repeat business.
* Support in-house sales growth by identifying cross-sell, upsell, and rental-to-purchase opportunities.
* Collaborate with operations, fleet, and marketing teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Partner with Sales to transition accounts as they scale.

***Rental Operations: Contracts, Check-Out & Check-In***

* Oversee the full rental contract process, ensuring agreements, terms, credit approvals, insurance certificates, and required customer documentation are complete and accurate before equipment leaves the yard.
* Manage equipment check-out, including availability, reservations, pre-rental inspections, and delivery and pickup scheduling.
* Manage equipment check-in, including return inspections and documentation of condition, damage, missing items, and usage, and ensure related charges are billed.
* Ensure rental contracts are invoiced accurately, closed out in a timely manner, and resolve billing questions.
* Track fleet availability and provide direction to employees to maximize fleet utilization.
* Ensure that Sales, Repair, and Production teams are informed of changes to company rental policies and services.
* Assist fleet and maintenance departments with equipment turnaround, off-site repairs, and fleet replacement goals and objectives.
* Manage after-hours emergency breakdown calls as required.

***Customer Service***

* Monitor and review calls or other correspondence between employees and customers to ensure consistency of customer experience.
* Resolve escalated customer complaints and issues while maintaining professionalism and prompt follow through.
* Prepare knowledge-based documents such as summaries and responses to frequently asked questions.
* Backfill Rental Coordinator duties as needed to ensure department consistency.

***Reporting, Forecasting & Planning***

* Maintain accurate records in CRM and ERP systems, including pipeline activity, quotes, contracts, forecasts, and account plans.
* Utilize and optimize CRM software to collect and report data on customer inquiries, complaints, and rental activity.
* Collect customer data, competitive rental rates, and utilization to inform pricing and account strategies.
* Identify opportunities to update or improve internal procedures and make recommendations to supervisor.

***General***

* Performs other related duties as assigned.
* Drive customer owned and/or company vehicles as needed.

**Qualifications:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Must have a valid driver’s license. Must be able to pass DOT physical and drug testing requirements.

**Education and/or Experience:**

Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Minimum of three years of inside sales, rental, or customer service experience required.

Experience in equipment/vehicle rental, highway safety, or a related industry preferred.

Previous experience in a supervisory role preferred.

**Language Skills:**

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, blueprints, operating and maintenance instructions and procedure manuals. Ability to speak effectively before groups of employees of the organization.

**Mathematical Skills:**

Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, and percentages.

**Computer Skills:**

Proficient in the use of MS Office Suite. Experience with CRM software preferred; familiarity with ERP or rental management systems is a plus.

**Reasoning Ability:**

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, or schedule form.

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, and talk/hear. The employee will be required to safely get in and out of a medium duty trucks. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, Distance vision, peripheral vision, and depth perception. Must be able to pass a DOT physical (basic health screen and drug test). Organized with attention to detail.

Ability to coach and mentor employees.

Valid driver’s license /and able to pass an insurance background check.

7bc42fc5487b29b38367.title: Infusion Supply Coordinator
7bc42fc5487b29b38367.description:
**About AmeriPharma**

AmeriPharma is a rapidly growing healthcare company where you will have the opportunity to contribute to our joint success on a daily basis. We value new ideas, creativity, and productivity. We like people who are passionate about their roles and people who like to grow and change as the company evolves.

**AmeriPharma’s Benefits**

* Full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life that fits your lifestyle and goals
* Great pay and general compensation structures
* Employee assistance program to assist with mental health, legal questions, financial counseling etc.
* Comprehensive PTO and sick leave options
* 401k program
* Plenty of opportunities for growth and advancement
* Company sponsored outings and team-building events
* Casual Fridays

  

**Job Summary**

The Infusion Supply Coordinator supports safe and efficient home infusion therapy by managing patient-specific infusion supplies and equipment in coordination with Pharmacy, Nursing, and other operational teams. This role is responsible for reviewing and adjusting supply quantities based on patient therapy needs, nursing requests, utilization, and established workflows, ensuring that supplies are sent correctly for the specific catheter line in use to support safe infusion therapy. The coordinator serves as a primary resource for infusion supply questions and is expected to validate that requested supplies are appropriate for the patient's therapy and administration method before changes are made. The role also assists with identifying alternative products, researching new supply options, and submitting requests for new items when current inventory does not meet patient or operational needs. This position requires strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and an understanding of home infusion supplies, equipment, and patient-specific therapy requirements.

**Job Details**

* 100% remote position
* **Schedule**: Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 4:30pm PST
* **Salary Range**: $25 to $30 Hourly, DOE

  

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Manage patient-specific infusion supplies and adjust quantities based on therapy requirements, frequency of administration, patient utilization, and nursing or pharmacy requests.
* Review and validate supply requests to ensure the item and quantity requested are appropriate for the patient's therapy, vascular access, administration method, and frequency of use.
* Identify potentially excessive, insufficient, duplicate, or inappropriate supply requests and clarify discrepancies with Pharmacy, Nursing, or other appropriate team members before processing changes.
* Collaborate with pharmacists and nursing staff when supply needs require clinical clarification or when requested changes may affect medication administration, vascular access care, or patient safety.
* Research alternative or substitute supplies when requested products are unavailable, discontinued, backordered, or no longer preferred.
* Compare alternative products for intended use, compatibility, packaging, availability, and operational feasibility before recommending options for review.
* Submit requests for new supplies or products when existing inventory does not adequately meet patient, nursing, pharmacy, or operational needs.
* Maintain and update patient supply profiles to accurately reflect current therapy requirements and prevent unnecessary or outdated supplies from continuing to ship.
* Review recurring supply quantities and utilization to identify opportunities to reduce waste, prevent shortages, and improve supply standardization.
* Coordinate with Pharmacy, Nursing, Intake, Production, Shipping, and other departments to resolve supply-related questions and ensure patients receive the appropriate supplies for treatment.
* Assist with urgent or same-day supply needs by evaluating the request, determining what is required, and coordinating appropriate fulfillment or escalation.
* Monitor supply inventory concerns and communicate anticipated shortages, unusual utilization, or product needs to the appropriate Production or Supply Chain leadership.
* Assist with supply standardization initiatives by identifying commonly used products, unnecessary variation, and opportunities to establish preferred supply options.
* Maintain accurate documentation of patient-specific supply changes, special requirements, substitutions, and relevant communications in the pharmacy system.
* Support equipment management, including coordinating equipment needs, replacements, returns, and pickups as applicable.
* Assist with equipment recovery efforts and collaborate with Specialty Pharmacy or other departments when demand letters or additional follow-up are required.
* Participate in inventory audits, supply utilization reviews, quality improvement initiatives, and workflow development to improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary supply costs.
* Escalate clinical questions to a pharmacist or nurse when a supply request requires clinical judgment beyond the scope of the coordinator role.
* Additional duties and responsibilities in different areas of the department on an as-need basis or determined by management
* Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, collaboration, and service excellence.
* Take primary ownership of: Patient-specific supply quantities and adjustments, review and validation of supply requests, supply utilization and waste reduction, alternative product research, new supply/product requests, patient supply profile accuracy, supply and equipment issue resolution, and cross-department coordination of infusion supply needs.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Previous experience in home infusion, specialty pharmacy, medical supplies, DME, pharmacy operations, healthcare supply chain, or a related setting preferred.
* Familiarity with infusion supplies, vascular access supplies, administration sets, pumps, and related equipment.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills with the ability to evaluate whether supply quantities and requests are reasonable.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to research products, compare alternatives, and communicate findings clearly.
* Ability to manage multiple patient-specific requests while maintaining accuracy and appropriate prioritization.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with pharmacists, nurses, technicians, shipping personnel, and other interdisciplinary teams.
* Attention to detail
* Supply utilization and inventory awareness
* Critical thinking and problem solving
* Patient-specific supply management
* Cross-functional communication
* Research and product evaluation
* Documentation accuracy
* Prioritization and follow-through
* Cost and waste awareness
* Understanding of role boundaries and appropriate clinical escalation

  

**Education and Experience Requirements**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or healthcare-related education preferred.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using patient management or inventory systems such as CPR+ preferred.

  

**AmeriPharma’s Mission Statement**

Our goal is to achieve superior clinical and economic outcomes while maintaining the utmost compassion and care for our patients. It is our joint and individual responsibility daily to demonstrate to outpatients, prescribers, colleagues, and others that We Care!

**Physical Requirements**

The following physical activities described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions and expectations. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is continuously required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 20 pounds and occasionally lift/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus. The employee must have the ability to regularly walk commercial properties, parking areas, and exterior grounds; use stairs and access building operational areas as required; work in both office and field environments; and occasionally lift and carry light maintenance supplies or equipment.

**EEO Statement**

The above statements are intended to describe the work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required. The duties and responsibilities of this position are subject to change and other duties may be assigned or removed at any time. AmeriPharma values diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an AAP/EEO employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability or any other legally protected class.

d5b3e8632ea054b3e2de.description:
**Position Overview**

PRESTIGE PROTECTIVE COATINGS is seeking a detail-oriented Multi-Location Distribution Coordinator to support the movement of products, supplies, and materials between company locations, warehouses, and customer destinations. This role helps coordinate distribution schedules, monitor inventory availability, maintain accurate shipment records, and communicate with internal teams to ensure timely and organized deliveries.

The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, and comfortable managing multiple distribution priorities across different locations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Multi-Location Distribution Coordination**

* Coordinate product and material transfers between company locations and distribution points.
* Track distribution requests and monitor delivery schedules.
* Communicate with warehouse personnel, drivers, vendors, and internal departments regarding shipment status.
* Help prioritize distribution needs based on operational requirements.
* Follow up on delayed, incomplete, or outstanding transfers.

**Inventory & Stock Monitoring**

* Monitor inventory levels and product availability across assigned locations.
* Maintain records of incoming, outgoing, and transferred materials.
* Identify potential shortages, excess stock, or inventory discrepancies.
* Assist with coordinating replenishment requests between locations.

* Verify shipment information against purchase orders and distribution requests.

* Assist with resolving routine shipping, receiving, and fulfillment issues.

* Serve as a coordination point for distribution-related inquiries.
* Provide updates to relevant teams about delivery schedules and transfer progress.
* Maintain distribution schedules, tracking spreadsheets, and internal reports.
* Organize documentation and ensure records are updated accurately.
* Escalate significant delays, shortages, or operational concerns to management.

**Required:**

* Previous experience in distribution, logistics, inventory control, shipping, or operations support.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Good written and verbal communication abilities.
* Basic computer proficiency, including spreadsheets and inventory or order-tracking systems.
* Ability to manage multiple requests and changing priorities.
* Strong attention to detail and accurate recordkeeping.

**Preferred:**

* Experience coordinating inventory or shipments across multiple locations.
* Familiarity with warehouse, distribution, or transportation procedures.
* Experience using inventory management, order processing, or enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.
* Background in manufacturing, coatings, construction materials, or industrial supply operations.

**Core Competencies**

* Multi-location coordination
* Distribution scheduling
* Inventory tracking
* Shipment documentation
* Problem-solving
* Cross-department communication
* Organization and follow-through
* Accuracy and accountability

**How to Apply:** Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their resume and relevant work experience for consideration.

Pay: $51,800.00 - $62,400.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

**Michigan Educator Workforce Initiative - Program Data & Operations Associate**  
(Part-time temporary, remote)  
  
**Who We Are**

Michigan Educator Workforce Initiative (MEWI) is a hub for educator talent. MEWI adopts a “systems-adjacent” approach, working closely with K-12 districts, early learning centers, and higher education institutions to design and support innovative approaches to recruiting and developing teachers and school leaders. We are committed to hiring a team that represents the diversity our state offers.

**What We Do**

MEWI is an adaptive organization that plays the roles necessary to foster innovation and long-term, systematic capacity-building for Michigan’s educator workforce pipeline. Depending on the context, MEWI plays flexible roles: designing, implementing, funding, and supporting innovative programs to recruit, develop, retain, and elevate new and veteran teachers and school leaders. MEWI captures insights and learnings from our work to share with systems leaders, policy makers, parents, and community leaders and convenes educators to share best practices, collaborate, and problem-solve.

**What You’ll Do**

The Program Data & Operations Associate will build and manage the data systems that track MEWI program participants and outcomes and will own the data reports and deliverables that program teams, funders, and grant managers rely on. You will also provide targeted operational support for program meetings and events. You will work closely with MEWI’s operations team and multiple Directors of Programs to ensure program data is accurate, well-documented, and ready to inform decisions.

**Who You Are**

The ideal candidate for this role:

* Is a critical and analytical thinker. This person likes to get in the weeds, enjoys analyzing data, and translates findings clearly for different stakeholders.
* Is detail-oriented and a creative problem solver. This person catches errors before they spread, anticipates challenges, and proactively solves complex problems.
* Is self-directed and independent. This person will work independently on complex projects and needs to be comfortable with ambiguity.
* Has strong project management skills. This person tracks multiple deliverables and deadlines at once and connects the dots across programs and teams.
* Has excellent communication skills. This person writes and presents clearly and adapts communication to different audiences.
* Takes ownership of their work while operating within a feedback-rich culture. This person puts solutions forward, adapts based on input from MEWI staff, and documents their work so MEWI staff can sustain it after the contract ends.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree (or higher) from an accredited college or university
* 2-4 years of experience in data management, operations, and/or project management involving multiple functions
* Experience developing, using, and maintaining data collection and management tools and systems
* Experience producing data reports, dashboards, and presentations for internal and external audiences
* Proficient with software and technology, including Zoom, Microsoft Suite, and/or Google Suite
* Experience and comfort working in a virtual environment
* (Preferred) Experience using Google Data Studio, Asana, and Qualtrics
* (Preferred) Experience maintaining records and grant reporting

**Responsibilities**

*Systems management*

* Support in building out a comprehensive project plan
* Maintain data collection tools and systems for program functions
* Manage participant and program data in Google Suite, including Google Data Studio and related tools, ensuring records are complete, accurate, and current
* Conduct regular data quality audits against established standards, resolving discrepancies with program teams
* Document all systems, processes, and data definitions so MEWI staff and its partners can sustain them after the contract ends

*Data reporting and deliverables*

* Monitor progress against deliverables; identify and propose solutions to challenges and elevate concerns appropriately
* Produce data reports, dashboards, presentations, and written summaries that share program information with MEWI team members and external stakeholders
* Analyze program data and translate findings into actionable insights for program teams
* Prepare data and supporting documentation for funder and grant reporting deadlines

*Operational support*

* Support operations for virtual and in-person program meetings and events, including registration and communications
* Collaborate with the operations team and Director of Program to streamline program processes and data flows
* Provide responsive support to program stakeholders on data, systems, and logistics questions

**Anticipated Schedule**

The selected individual will work as a part-time temporary employee with an estimated 8-10 hours per week. This position will operate from November 2026 through June 2027.  
  
**Compensation**

An hourly rate of $35-$45 (commensurate with experience). As a part-time temporary employee, this role is not eligible for MEWI employee benefits.

f19bcff4e1a52953d7ed.title: Global Customer Operations Transformation Lead
f19bcff4e1a52953d7ed.description:
We’re a high-impact, global nonprofit social enterprise that believes in using technology for the greater good. Since 1987, we’ve been building partnerships and alliances with individuals, corporations, nonprofits, and governments across the globe – all committed to helping nonprofits fully access the profound power of technology and a connected world — and use it to improve lives.  
  
But we won’t stop there: as technology and global needs change, so do we. We’re creating new, community-driven platforms and mobile apps and are enhancing our offerings so that nonprofits around the world have the resources they need to build a brighter future for millions of individuals.  
  
We’re innovators, leaders, influencers, social entrepreneurs, and technologists drawn together by a shared vision: to make the world a better place through technology. Join us!  
  
**Full-time engagement | 8-9 months**

1. **Engagement Overview**

TechSoup is seeking an experienced Global Customer Operations Transformation Lead for an approximately 8-9 month, full-time engagement. The individual or consulting firm will provide senior, hands-on leadership for TechSoup's Global Customer Operations Transformation, working across Customer Service, Validation support, technology, AI and automation, process redesign, workforce transition, and change management.

This is not primarily an advisory engagement. TechSoup is looking for a leader who can take the transformation from design through implementation, stabilization, and handover. Significant current-state analysis and target-state design work has already been completed. The next phase requires dedicated leadership to convert those decisions into an integrated implementation plan, drive execution across multiple teams, resolve dependencies, establish new operating practices, and ensure that the resulting model becomes sustainable day-to-day operations.

2. **Transformation Context**

TechSoup is redesigning how nonprofit organizations receive support, complete registration and validation, and gain access to products and services globally. The transformation combines workflow redesign, AI-enabled automation, human support, technology implementation, and organizational change. This redesign and implementation work will also lay down the foundational structure for future business needs including sales, membership engagement, and entry point to TechSoup.

The transformation covers three connected areas

* Global Customer Service: shared knowledge resources, conversational AI, global live chat with human escalation, tickets, callbacks, office hours, routing, service hours, and chat quality review.
* Global Customer Registration and Validation: search, claim or register organizations; automate organization, agent, eligibility, and fraud checks; provide human review for exceptions; support checkout checks and revalidation; and phase migration toward Dynamics.
* Global Operating Model and Workforce Transition: define service tiers, roles, queue ownership, training, KPI baselines, quality monitoring, governance, and a phased delivery plan.

The engagement must treat these areas as one operating transformation. The need is broader than implementing a platform or adding staff. Technology, process, service delivery, organizational structure, roles, training, measurement, and change management must move together.

3. **Purpose of the Engagement**

A. Turn the target design into an executable program

Translate the existing design, decisions, and workstreams into a single integrated transformation roadmap with clear deliverables, owners, dependencies, milestones, decision points, risks, acceptance criteria, KPI measurement, and resource requirements.

B. Drive implementation

Actively lead execution across Customer Service and Validation rather than serving only as an advisor. The lead must be comfortable moving from strategy to process design, technology, people, implementation, measurement, and operational stabilization.

C. Build the new Global Customer Operations model

* Global workflows and clear ownership
* Defined service levels and standards
* AI-enabled approach with effective human escalation
* Quality management and workforce capability
* Appropriate regional and country exceptions within a globally consistent model

D. Leave behind a sustainable organization

By the end of the engagement, TechSoup leadership should be able to run the new model without continued dependence on the contractor. Knowledge transfer, documentation, operating routines, KPI ownership, governance, and management capability are required outcomes.

4. **Scope of Work**

4.1 Transformation Program Leadership

* Build and maintain the integrated transformation roadmap.
* Translate strategy and decisions into implementation requirements.
* Establish clear workstream accountability and decision rights.
* Maintain dependencies, risks, issues, actions, and decisions.
* Prepare and facilitate project-team, KPI, and steering reviews.
* Identify delivery obstacles and bring decisions to the appropriate leaders quickly.
* Maintain focus on business outcomes rather than activity completion.
* Provide concise executive reporting on progress, decisions, risks, resources, and KPI movement.

4.2 Customer Operations Transformation and Data Management

Lead the operationalization of a global Customer Service model that includes:

* A clear digital strategy
* A shared, country-aware knowledge capability
* Global approach to customer interactions (including data management), chats, tickets and solution process
* An operating model and structure to support escalations and program consultation where appropriate
* Improved process for quality assurance and higher CSAT and better user experience
* Feedback loops into knowledge, policy, and training

4.3 Operating Model and Workforce Transformation

This work is central to the engagement and must not be treated as secondary to technology implementation. The lead will help design and implement:

* Global Customer Operations structure, and definition of functional roles
* Responsibilities and decision rights
* Service tiers and skill-based agent structure
* Workforce coverage and capacity model
* Training and capability requirements
* Quality-management responsibilities
* Transition from current roles to the future structure

4.4 AI and Technology Enablement

The lead does not necessarily need to be the technical implementer, but must be technically fluent enough to lead an AI-enabled Customer Operations transformation. Relevant experience should include several of the following:

* Knowledge management
* CRM and case management
* Intelligent routing and workflow automation
* Customer-service analytics
* AI quality assurance, monitoring, and governance

5**. Performance and Measurement**

The lead will establish reliable operational management mechanisms, validate KPI definitions and baselines, assign owners, and implement recurring reporting. Current project targets.

The lead should confirm measurement methodology, data availability, exclusions, segmentation, and baseline integrity before using these measures for acceptance or benefit claims. AI deflection should be reviewed together with resolution, quality, escalation, customer experience, and operating efficiency, rather than optimized in isolation.

6. **Expected Deliverables**

Mobilization and program control

* Integrated transformation implementation plan
* Confirmed workstream structure and RACI/decision rights
* Dependency map
* Risk, issue, action, and decision registers
* Governance cadence and executive reporting format
* KPI baseline and measurement framework

Organization and transition

* Future-state Global Customer Operations operating model
* Roles, responsibilities, service tiers, and staffing/capacity model
* Training and capability plan
* Change and communications plan
* Operational playbook and leadership dashboard
* Formal operational handoff and knowledge transfer

7. **Candidate or Firm Requirements**

Required experience

* 10+ years of relevant experience in global customer operations, service transformation, contact centers, or customer-experience operations.
* Leadership of at least two significant customer or service-operations transformations from design through implementation.
* Experience leading global or multi-region operations.
* Experience redesigning customer-support processes and organizational operating models.
* Strong program and transformation-management capability.
* Experience implementing AI or automation in customer-facing operations.
* Experience with CRM or customer-service platforms.
* Experience designing KPIs, service levels, quality frameworks, and operational dashboards.
* Demonstrated change-management experience, particularly where employee roles and responsibilities changed.
* Ability to work directly with senior executives and hands-on with operational and technical teams.

Strongly preferred

* Microsoft tech stacks in Customer Service experience.
* Experience with global nonprofit, membership, marketplace, or service organizations.
* Experience building 24 by 7 models.
* Knowledge-management transformation experience.
* Experience combining AI-enabled self-service with human-supported service.
* Experience with compliance, KYC-like verification, or other exception-based operational processes.

8. **Profile We Are Looking For**

The strongest candidate is likely to have served in one or more of the following roles:

* VP or Head of Customer Operations
* VP or Head of Customer Experience
* Customer Service Transformation Director
* Contact Center Transformation Leader
* Customer Operations Operating Model Lead
* Senior Customer Operations or CX Transformation Consultant

9. **Engagement Model**

Duration

Approximately 8-9 months

Commitment

Full time

Provider model

Individual independent contractor or consulting firm providing a named senior lead

Working style

Embedded with TechSoup's global project team

Expected focus

Implementation, operational readiness, stabilization, and handover

**Requirement for a consulting company:**

The proposed named transformation lead must be committed substantially full time for the duration of the engagement. TechSoup is not seeking a partner-led strategy engagement that transitions delivery primarily to junior consultants. Any substitution of the named lead requires TechSoup approval.

**The hourly compensation range for this full-time, contract engagement is approximately $58–$72 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.** **depending on experience, qualifications, and scope alignment. The final rate will be determined based on the scope of services, relevant skills and experience, specialized expertise, location, and market considerations. This is an independent contractor engagement and is not eligible for TechSoup employee benefits.**

* Lead the sourcing and acquisition strategy for Data Operations, building on its existing network foundation to meet future needs.
* Identify and evaluate new data sources and various acquisition approaches that improve Data Operations sourcing coverage and operational requirements.
* Partner with Data Operations and Product leaders to understand evolving data needs and priorities.
* Make strategic sourcing decisions that balance quality, coverage, cost, and business value.
* Partner with commercial teams to build strategic relationships at OEMs, expanding Data Operations access to global and digital data streams.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and develop the data acquisition team, setting clear priorities, goals, and performance expectations.
* Grow the team's relationship network across data assets, including OEM, data supplier, and digital data relationships.
* Coach team members on negotiation, supplier management, and governance practices, and build backup coverage for critical supplier relationships.

**Supplier & Licensing Management**

* Manage relationships with external data suppliers and strategic partners.
* Lead supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, renewals, and performance reviews.
* Oversee data licensing, usage rights, and contractual obligations.
* Partner with Procurement, Legal, and Data Governance to ensure effective oversight.

**Supply Management & Resiliency**

* Establish contingency and backup sourcing plans for critical data assets.
* Monitor supplier risk and develop mitigation strategies to ensure uninterrupted data access.
* Ensure primary and secondary source coverage for critical data assets.

**Cost & Performance Management**

* Manage data supplier spend and identify opportunities to improve value and efficiency.
* Develop reporting and performance measures for sourcing, costs, and supplier effectiveness.
* Provide leadership with clear visibility into data supply risks, opportunities, and investment needs.

**Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish standards and processes for data sourcing, acquisition, and supplier management.
* Promote consistent practices across all data domains and business areas.
Drive continuous improvement to enhance sourcing efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness.  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Data Management, Technology, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in business development, data acquisition, data operations, supplier management, procurement, business operations, or a related discipline, including Director-level leadership.
* Experience leading teams.
* Experience negotiating supplier agreements and managing third-party relationships.
* Working knowledge of data licensing, contracts, governance, and risk management practices.
* Strong financial, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to influence decisions and drive outcomes across complex organizations.
* Polished presentation and negotiation skills.
Ability to personally own key supplier relationships while leading a team.  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in the automotive industry, dealership operations, automotive finance, or incentive administration.

* Background in Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Data Science, Business, or a related field.

* Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot Studio, or similar technologies.

* Experience with SQL, Python, VBA, or other automation and data tools.

* Understanding of regular expressions (RegEx) for data validation and pattern recognition.

* Knowledge of data governance and data quality frameworks.

* Experience developing standard operating procedures and process documentation.

* Customer service or customer support experience.

* Experience participating in process improvement or operational excellence initiatives.

**Compensation and Benefits**

This position has a starting salary range of $121,000 - 141,000 USD / $112,000 - 131,000 CAD. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

  
  

**Why Join JD Power**

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

* **We power our customers’ success.** Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

* **We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data.** We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.

* **We make things easy.** We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.

* **We get it done.** We focus on execution, accountability, and results.

* **We start with trust and prove it every day.** Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.

  

**Equal Opportunity & Accommodations**

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact careers@jdpower.com for accommodation request.

  

**Data Privacy**

However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. 7626beb2a20cc461a4ad.title: Sr. Sales Dvl Representative
7626beb2a20cc461a4ad.description:
**This is a Remote USA Role - Preferred Candidate Placement is the San Francisco Bay area.**

  

TE Connectivity (TE) is a leading global provider of highly engineered connectors and sensors with sales of over $15 billion to customers in more than 150 countries. They design, manufacture and market products for customers in a broad array of industries including automotive; consumer electronics; telecommunications; aerospace; defense & military; medical & healthcare; oil & gas/marine; and energy & utilities. With over 80,000 associates including 7,500 engineers and worldwide manufacturing, sales and customer service capabilities, TE Connectivity’s commitment is their customers’ advantage. TE Connectivity is an independent publicly traded company whose common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol “TEL.”

  

TE’s connectivity solutions are key enablers in our increasingly connected world. Safer and more advanced medical devices, smarter factories, connected vehicles, and data everywhere are underlying market trends creating significant opportunities for TE. TE’s dedication to innovation, focus on solutions for harsh environments, and commitment to delivering extraordinary customer experiences enable TE to capitalize on these opportunities and more.

Digital Data Networks Business Unit
  
The Cloud market is changing at an unprecedented pace, and the Digital Data Networks (DDN) Business Unit at TE Connectivity is at the heart of a continuously expanding connected life. Accordingly, DDN provides responsive, iterative, and fundamentally agile capabilities conceived, designed and manufactured to support today's demands. DDN’s customers are building the devices and the infrastructure that is redefining what information technology means. Their products push markets and meet the ever-changing need of the evolving, more connected, data-driven world. They are enhancing the way the world does business, focusing on the most important things and staying agile and responsive to the needs of a faster, more connected world.This business has high performing yet complex manufacturing operations encompassing 10,000+ SKUs, 300,000+ orders and 10 million+ shipments through 10 distribution centers annually, all while launching upwards of 50 new products per year.Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat and Twitter.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

TE Connectivity seeks an experienced and dynamic Sr. Sales Development Representative to support a global team serving one of the world’s leading hyperscale customers within the AI and Cloud Hyperscale sector. This individual will play a key role in expanding TE’s position within the account by developing customer relationships, identifying and advancing new opportunities, and coordinating TE’s internal resources to successfully execute customer programs.

  

The role will complement existing account coverage while expanding TE’s relationships across customer engineering, sourcing, supply chain, and program management organizations. As part of the front-end team, the Sr. SDR will be a liaison between these customer roles and the internal support from within TE.

  

This individual will be expected to develop strong working relationships with key customer stakeholders, understand and organize project requirements, timelines, commercial opportunities and decision points, and translate those needs into clear actions for TE’s Product Management, Engineering, Operations and other internal teams.

  

The successful candidate will bring a growth-oriented mindset, strong commercial acumen, technical aptitude, and the ability to operate effectively in a highly matrixed global organization. This is a hands-on customer-facing role requiring someone who can independently develop relationships, establish structure around emerging opportunities, and drive actions to closure.

  

The role will appeal to an experienced sales professional who wants substantial ownership within a strategically important hyperscale account and the opportunity for further personal and career growth as TE continues to expand its AI and data center business.

**Specific Job Duties**
-----------------------

**Strategic Account Management**
  

* Support the development and execution of the strategic account plan for one of TE’s largest hyperscale customers.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with project managers, engineering teams, sourcing organizations and other key customer stakeholders.
* Establish credibility as a responsive and knowledgeable commercial partner who can connect customer requirements with TE capabilities.
* Coordinate closely with account leadership to ensure clear ownership, consistent customer communication and alignment on account priorities.

  

**Business Development**
  

* Identify, qualify and develop new design opportunities, with particular focus on data center applications.
* Engage customers early in the design cycle to understand program requirements, architecture, timelines, volumes, commercial value, qualification needs and key decision points.
* Build and maintain a structured pipeline of new programs and design opportunities.
* Collaborate with TE Product Management, Engineering, System Architecture, Operations and Marketing teams to develop solutions that meet customer requirements and expand TE content.
* Identify opportunities to leverage successful designs across platforms, programs and data center architectures.

Program and Opportunity Management
  

* Translate customer discussions into clear internal requirements, priorities, owners and timelines.
* Maintain visibility to key customer programs from initial engagement through design-in, qualification, sourcing and production.
* Drive internal follow-up across Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Pricing and other functions to keep customer commitments and commercial opportunities on track.
* Identify risks, gaps and dependencies early and escalate appropriately when additional support or decisions are required.
* Provide clear and concise reporting on program status, opportunity value, milestones, customer actions and internal deliverables.

Market Analysis
  

* Maintain awareness of industry trends, hyperscale data center architectures, AI infrastructure requirements and competitive activity.
* Develop an understanding of emerging architectures and interconnect requirements and translate those trends into actionable opportunities for TE.
* Engage with customers and ecosystem partners to identify market and technology trends that can accelerate growth of TE’s DDN business.

**Specific Job Duties (Continued)**
-----------------------------------

**Customer Engagement**
  

* Maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships by understanding customer business needs, technical requirements and program priorities.
* Proactively develop relationships beyond established account contacts to broaden TE’s engagement across the customer organization.
* Establish a regular cadence of customer interaction, including in-person meetings in the Bay Area as appropriate and occasional global travel as needed.
* Identify and respond to key customer needs, converting opportunities in the sales funnel into design wins and revenue.

  

**Delivering Revenue Targets**
  

* Contribute to achievement of annual sales and growth targets within the assigned account.
* Develop and maintain a robust opportunity pipeline, sales forecast and key account metrics.
* Own assigned opportunities from initial identification through commercial award and production.
* Develop credible estimates of program timing, volume, content and revenue potential to support account forecasting and resource prioritization.
* Expand TE content and market share within assigned product areas and customer organizations.

**Collaboration**
  

* Work closely with the broader account team to maintain clear responsibility and coordinated engagement across customer organizations and product areas.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, System Architecture, Operations, Quality and Customer Service to convert customer requirements into executable internal actions.
* Effectively influence internal stakeholders in a matrixed organization without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Coordinate with TE teams globally to support development, qualification and production activities. Some evening communication with Asia will be required on a weekly basis.

**What your background should look like**
-----------------------------------------

**Professional Experience/Qualifications**

  

The Sr. Sales Development Representative will be an experienced sales professional with demonstrated success managing technically complex customers and developing new business opportunities.

Experience within hyperscale data centers, AI infrastructure, power distribution, interconnect or related markets is strongly preferred.

  

* 7+ years of relevant sales, account management or business development experience, preferably supporting Tier 1 hyperscale, cloud infrastructure or related technology customers.

* Undergraduate degree in engineering, business or a related field is required. A technical undergraduate degree is preferred given the customer and product complexity of the role. An advanced degree, such as a Master of Business Administration, is desirable.

* Experience in the AI, high-speed computing, data center or related infrastructure industry.

* Knowledge of interconnect, cable assembly, busbar, or related electromechanical products and associated manufacturing processes.

* Proven ability to identify and develop opportunities from early customer engagement through design-in and commercial award.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple simultaneous customer programs with different requirements, stakeholders and timelines.

* Strong commercial skills, including opportunity sizing, forecasting, pricing and negotiation.

* Ability to understand technical customer requirements and translate those requirements into commercial opportunities and internal actions.

* Proven ability to establish relationships across engineering, sourcing, supply chain and program management organizations.

* Skilled at communicating and leveraging differentiated value propositions.

* Ability to understand the big picture while maintaining sufficient attention to detail to drive program requirements and commitments to closure.

* Strong business sense and industry expertise with a growth and hunting mentality.

* Strong familiarity with CRM tools and systems, including Salesforce, is desirable.

* Technical aptitude; engineering or comparable technical background is strongly preferred.

* Ability to travel approximately 10 to 20%, including international travel as required.

**Additional Qualifications**
-----------------------------

**Leadership Qualifications**

  

The Sr. Sales Development Representative will be expected to demonstrate leadership through ownership, influence, customer credibility and execution, rather than primarily through direct people management.

**The Sr. Sales Development Representative should possess the following skills:**

  

* Sales Leadership: Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, develop customer relationships and lead cross-functional teams toward commercial outcomes. Strong relationship-development, collaboration and influencing skills.
* Ownership and Accountability: Ability to take ownership of customer opportunities and drive internal and external actions through completion.
* Delivery and Results Oriented: Ability to find solutions and generate results in a dynamic environment with multiple competing priorities.
* Influencing Skills: Keen listening, open-mindedness and strong interpersonal skills, enabling effective alliances with internal and external stakeholders.
* Communication Skills: Comfortable communicating both formally and informally with customer stakeholders, technical teams and senior executives. Able to consolidate complex program activity into clear requirements, actions, timelines and business implications.
* Customer Development: Strong ability to establish new relationships and expand engagement within complex customer organizations rather than relying solely on established contacts.
* Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced global environment where flexibility, resilience, comfort with ambiguity and adaptability to change are essential.
* Technical Curiosity: Able and willing to develop sufficient understanding of customer architectures, applications and TE technologies to engage credibly with both commercial and technical stakeholders.

**ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY**

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

  

**COMPENSATION**
  

* Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $113.5k - 170.3k annually (subject to change dependent on physical location)
* Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity.
* Total Compensation = Base Salary + Incentive(s) + Benefits

  

**BENEFITS**
  

* A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits.

**EOE, Including Disability/Vets**

  

**IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
  
TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity **never requests payment or fees** from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come **only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com**. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.

Job Country: United States

Travel Required: Less than 10%

0f253daa27745688bb98.title: Operations & Transaction Manager (Real Estate Investment/Wholesale)
0f253daa27745688bb98.description:
**Job Title: Operations & Transaction Manager (Real Estate Investment/Wholesale)**

**Location: Remote / Kansas (Topeka, Wichita, Salina)**

**Job Type: Full-Time**

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base Salary: $35,000 - $45,000 (Depending on experience)**
* **Performance Bonus: $150 - $250 bonus for every transaction that successfully closes. When you help push deals across the finish line, your earning potential grows. We are assertively spending and hiring toward the goal of >10 transactions per month.**
* **Health Stipend: $300 monthly health/wellness stipend (can be used toward your own premiums, out-of-pocket medical expenses, or taken as supplemental income. This is how we provide health insurance).**
* **Schedule: 100% Remote (Must be available during standard Central Time business hours).**
* **Paid Time Off: 10 days of PTO plus standard major Federal holidays.**
* **Tech Stipend: $50/month to cover high-speed internet/cell phone usage.**

**About Us**

**We are a fast-paced and expanding 21-year-old real estate investment company now operating in the Topeka, Wichita, and Salina, Kansas markets that values hard work and human dignity. We have a highly effective and long tenured offshore VA team that handles our front-line inbound calls, lead follow-up, and appointment setting. We are looking for a highly organized, US-based Operations & Transaction Manager to be our back-office hub. You will manage our CRM systems, oversee complex direct mail list management, and relentlessly drive signed contracts to the closing table. If you love creating order and ensuring no detail falls through the cracks in a healthy, principled environment where people are treated with respect, then this Seat is for you.**

**Our Core Values (Who We Are)**

**We operate our business on principles of hard work, integrity, and caring for others. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and hire strictly based on a candidate's ability to demonstrate these behavioral core values:**

* **Driven, Yet Gracious (A Refined Executor): We need someone who is highly motivated, goal-oriented, and knows how to drive a project across the finish line. However, maturity is key—you have learned how to achieve goals without running people over. You value relationships just as much as results and lead with a servant’s heart.**
* **Fiercely Honest & Kind: We do the right thing even when it is hard. We believe in speaking the truth in love to all sides of the transaction, combining candid honesty with genuine kindness.**
* **Clear Communicators: We eliminate confusion by communicating directly, clearly, and proactively. Our “Yes” is “Yes” and our “No” is “No”. We don't do passive aggressive. We don’t pass the buck. We identify and solve problems together.**
* **Mutual Respect: We deeply care for the needs of others—our sellers, our buyers, our team, and our partners—while also establishing healthy boundaries to ensure the success of the business. We don’t just look out for our own interests, but also for the interests of others.**
* **Diligent & Hard-Working: We bring a strong work ethic to everything we do, working not just for a paycheck, but because we believe our work serves a higher purpose. We go the second mile.**

**Role Summary**

**The Operations & Transaction Manager is the operational engine of the company. You will oversee our CRM architecture, manage day-to-day financial and vendor administration, meticulously scrub and prep our direct mail lists, and own the real estate transaction coordination from contract to close. Your primary goal is to remove administrative bottlenecks so the leadership team can focus entirely on high-level growth, closing deals, and community initiatives.**

**The 6 Core Roles & Accountabilities**

**1. List Management & Direct Mail Operations:**

* **Manage relationships with 4 distinct list-providing vendors to procure and organize seller data**
* **Perform high-level data scrubbing in Excel (removing duplicates, ensuring street name conformity like "St" vs "Street", formatting data)**
* **Accurately assign and track specific marketing phone numbers to their corresponding direct mail pieces to ensure perfect lead attribution.**

**2. CRM & Systems Hub:**

* **Own the CRM system architecture**
* **Ensure lead routing is flawless so our front-line VAs can operate efficiently**
* **Manage integrations and scripts with our answering service and ensure all VA-set appointments hit the leadership team's calendar perfectly**

**3. Transaction Coordination (Contract to Close):**

* **Take ownership of all properties once under contract, ensuring a smooth path to the closing table**
* **Coordinate with local title companies, manage DocuSign workflows, track Earnest Money (EM) deposits, review title commitment requirements, review settlement statements, and ensure all closing documents, amendments, and lien releases are executed accurately and on time**

**4. Financial Administration:**

* **Process inbound and outbound invoices and manage routine payments (via PayPal, QuickBooks Payment, contractor payouts, etc.)**
* **Manage utility setups, transfers, and cancellations for all properties**
* **Liaise directly with our CPA vendor to provide timesheets, transaction receipts, income, and necessary QuickBooks updates**

**5. Vendor, IT & Calendar Management:**

* **Act as the primary point of contact for IT, software platforms (Microsoft, Automated Genius, website hosting), and external marketing vendors.**
* **Book, confirm, and cancel property appointments (coordinating closely with partners like property managers, inspectors, buyers, sellers, etc.).**
* **Act as the US-based point of escalation if a VA encounters a complex issue they cannot handle.**

**6. Document Processes & Systems:**

* **Create and maintain simple, step-by-step checklists for your daily back-office tasks so the business runs on clear systems rather than just tribal knowledge.**
* **Write clear instructions for the offshore VA team so they can execute their tasks without confusion and let their "Yes" be "Yes."**
* **Proactively update our checklists when you find a better, faster way to do things, helping the entire team go the second mile with less friction.**

**How We Measure Success (Your Scorecard)**

* **List & Marketing Integrity: Zero errors in mail-piece tracking numbers or duplicate mailings due to poor data scrubbing**
* **Closing Compliance: 100% of transaction documents (Contract, Addendums, Amendments, Earnest Money, Third Party Authorizations, etc.) are submitted and verified within one business day of contract signing**
* **Systems Uptime: Zero missed utility payments, lapsed software subscriptions, or dropped vendor communications per month**
* **Pipeline Integrity: 100% of VA-set appointments are correctly tagged, routed, and calendar-synced in Microsoft Outlook without manual intervention from the leadership team**

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Advanced Excel Competency: You must be highly proficient in Excel for heavy data sorting, deduplication, text formatting, and standardizing large datasets**
* **Proven experience in real estate transaction coordination, operations management, or as a high-level Executive Assistant**
* **Deep familiarity with CRMs (REI BlackBook, RESimpli, Salesforce experience is a massive plus)**
* **Proficiency with digital transaction tools (DocuSign), basic financial software (QuickBooks), and Microsoft products (especially Outlook and Excel)**
* **Relentless attention to detail—you do not let things slip through the cracks**
* **Strong communication skills to effectively manage title companies, buyers, sellers, and external vendors**

**How to Apply**

**Please send your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your experience with real estate transaction coordination, CRM management, and Excel data scrubbing to colm@bluestemproperty.com .**

***Attention to detail is critical for this role. To apply, you MUST include the word 'BlueStem' in the subject line of your email. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.***

Pay: $53,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Experience:

* Real estate • transaction coordination : 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

0cdf8d4ec89083ec2b41.title: Fraud Support Analyst
0cdf8d4ec89083ec2b41.description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

  

**Fraud Detection | Transaction Monitoring | Risk Analysis | SQL | Power BI | Fraud Operations**

Join our team as a **Fraud Support Analyst**, supporting fraud prevention and risk management through terminal reviews, merchant validation, transaction monitoring, fraud investigations, and data analysis.

In this role, you will primarily support the Misaligned Terminal Blocking Solution by reviewing flagged terminals, validating merchant legitimacy, and maintaining block lists.

You will also analyze transactional and operational data to identify fraud patterns, anomalies, vulnerabilities, and emerging risks, partnering with cross-functional teams to strengthen fraud controls and deliver accurate, actionable, and auditable decisions within established service level agreements (SLAs).

**Responsibilities**

**Terminal Review & Fraud Investigation**

* Review system-flagged terminals using established fraud investigation criteria and public or third-party sources to validate merchant legitimacy and identify misaligned, suspicious, or corrupt terminals.
* Research store websites, business listings, licensing records, Google Maps, and other available sources to support merchant validation and fraud detection decisions.
* Add, update, or remove flagged terminals and maintain fraud block lists in accordance with standard operating procedures and SLAs.
* Document evidence, findings, and actions to maintain auditability and compliance with applicable policies, regulations, and governance requirements.

**Fraud Analysis & Reporting**

* Extract, integrate, and analyze data from multiple systems to identify fraud trends, transaction anomalies, vulnerabilities, and operational risks.
* Monitor fraud strategies and controls to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Generate and analyze fraud reports, block list updates, dashboards, and activity summaries.
* Communicate fraud findings, trends, risks, and recommendations to Fraud Operations, internal leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, and clients.

**Cross-Functional Support**

* Partner with Fraud Operations, Technical Support, Product/Platform, and Client Support teams to define analytical requirements, escalate issues, troubleshoot problems, and improve fraud prevention solutions.
* Support fraud teams by researching issues, analyzing data, and assisting with technical and operational troubleshooting.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, or a related field plus at least one year of relevant experience; or equivalent professional experience in lieu of a degree.
* If substituting professional experience for a degree, at least three years of experience in fraud analysis, fraud operations, risk analysis, business analysis, data analysis, transaction monitoring, statistical reporting, or a related analytical role.
* Experience interpreting complex data, identifying trends and anomalies, developing practical recommendations, and communicating findings to stakeholders.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL.
* Experience developing interactive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.
* Strong data analysis, data mining, data management, interpretation, and visualization skills, including experience working with large datasets from multiple systems.
* Proficiency with Microsoft tools including Copilot, Excel, Outlook, Word, Teams, and PowerPoint, with the ability to learn additional analytical technologies.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to make independent, data-driven decisions, manage competing priorities, and meet SLA-driven deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing technical documentation, reports, queries, presentations, and explaining findings to nontechnical audiences.
* Must be either a U.S. Citizen or a Lawful Permanent Resident.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree, Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) certification, or another recognized fraud or risk certification.
* Experience in fraud detection, fraud prevention, risk operations, compliance, payments, or financial services.
* Experience with fraud rules, transaction monitoring, case management systems, operational SLAs, and workflow-driven processes.
* Ability to interpret basic system logic and partner with technical teams to troubleshoot fraud-related issues.

**Work Environment**

* Works primarily with fraud monitoring applications, analytical reports, dashboards, and Microsoft tools.
* Must be able to respond promptly to time-sensitive fraud alerts and SLA-driven tasks.
* Regular collaboration with Fraud Operations, Technical Support, Product/Platform, Client Support, internal leadership, and clients.

**Why Join Us**

This role provides the opportunity to combine fraud investigation, data analytics, SQL, transaction monitoring, and risk analysis to help identify suspicious activity and strengthen fraud prevention controls. You’ll work across fraud, technical, product, and client-facing teams while developing expertise in data-driven fraud detection and operational risk management.

**Flexible Working**

At Conduent, we want you to be yourself. We recognize that everyone is different and that how people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.

In this role, you can expect the following working conditions:

* **Remote work**: Enjoy the convenience of working from home and maximize your time by unplugging at the end of your workday.

**Working For You**

Perks and rewards designed for you:

**Health and Welfare Benefits:** Our health and welfare benefits can be tailored to fit you and your family's needs and start on the first day of employment

**Retirement Savings:** We will support you as you save for your future.

**Employee Discounts:** We offer you access to a vast selection of global, national, and local discounts on merchandise, services, travel, and more.

**Career Growth Opportunities:** We help you thrive, so together, we can grow. We provide opportunities to advance your career with a vast portfolio of businesses and a global footprint.

**Paid Training:** Earn while you learn and continue to grow with access to award-winning learning platforms throughout your Conduent career.

**Paid time off:** We provide attractive paid time off packages designed for you to enjoy your life away from work.

**Great Work Environment:** We are proud of our award-winning culture and the recognition we’ve received for our diversity efforts.

**Join Us**

At Conduent, we are one team, one mission. We understand that our success is directly related to the success of our associates.

We strive to create a culture where you can:

* Bring your authentic self to work.
* Grow and thrive, both personally and professionally.
* Make a difference with our clients, in our communities, and with the millions of people we support.

When you join Conduent, you are engaged in creating the future - both our company’s and your own. With more than 60,000 associates across 24 countries, we will provide you the opportunity to grow with a team of people who will challenge and inspire you to be the best!
