660cd4a976783168d397.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We're constantly reimagining what's possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

As a **Healthcare Billing Recovery Outreach Specialist I (SCA)**, you are assigned health insurance carrier, auto/home/worker's comp insurance carrier, or legal representatives ("stakeholders") of Group Healthcare (GHP) and/or Non-Group Healthcare Provider (NGHP) cases under the CMS Medicare Secondary Recovery Program. The Outreach team works with the Medicare Secondary Payer ("MSP") Debtor stakeholder community for Performant's assigned cases to address their high-priority questions and concerns regarding MSP case demands and related MSP correspondence. In addition, the Outreach team provides education and feedback to this MSP stakeholder community to help them understand the full scope of Performant's responsibilities and operating processes, as well as the stakeholder's corresponding responsibilities to ensure that MSP debts are paid timely and accurately.

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Leverage your knowledge and expertise in TPL/COB/MSP to review case documentation and any previous case work and activities completed by caseworkers to validate liability, responses to defenses regarding payment liability, status the account and letter correspondence, etc. in preparation to respond to and/or reach out to stakeholders.
* Answer questions (on the phone and/or in writing as appropriate) and/or provide information and education to the stakeholder(s) that will bring to successful payment or other appropriate account action.
* Responsible for monthly Outreach calls for assigned stakeholders which includes creating agendas, taking meeting minutes and responding to all phone calls or email inquiries.
* Initiate correct action with applicable party and documentation based upon payment option, actions required if review of case and/or new information is identified that may change the obligation to pay, or escalation in the event of refusal to pay.
* Updates client and/or company systems with clear and accurate information such as involved party(ies) contacting the CRC, notes from contact dialog, as well as account status updates as applicable.
* Initiates applicable claim activities; follows-up and follows through accordingly to ensure documentation and activity is on-time and accurate in accordance with policies and procedures.
* Support internal groups or functions with interpretation of EOB (explanation of benefits), as well as development of knowledge base and understanding of key concepts and terminology in healthcare billing and claims.
* Arrives to work on-time, works assigned schedule, and maintains regular good attendance.
* Follows and complies with company, departmental and client program policies, processes and procedures.

* Experience with Coordination of Benefits (COB), Third Party Liability (TPL), Medicare Secondary Payer (MSP) with proven expertise in gather and interpret Explanation of Benefits (EOB) to answer questions and resolve medical billing issues, including Medicare and Medicaid claims.

* Remarkable interpersonal and communication skills; ability to listen, be succinct and demonstrate positive customer service attitude and approach.

21f5942fcdeb6077adeb.title: SDR Operations Specialist
21f5942fcdeb6077adeb.description:
**About Megaport**

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

**Our Team Culture**

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

### **The Role**

Megaport is seeking a proactive, analytical, and commercially minded Sales Ops Specialist to support the Sales Development organization. This role is the dedicated Sales Operations partner to the global inbound and outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR) motions across brands, products, regions, and go-to-market programs.

In this role, you will be responsible for building, operating, measuring, and continuously improving the Sales Operations infrastructure that enables SDR leaders and their teams to perform effectively. The operational counterpart to SDR leadership provides the data, processes, systems, routing, reporting, analytics, governance, and operational discipline required to run a high-performing global SDR organization.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working at strategic and operational levels to: design a global SDR operating model, investigate specific lead-routing issues, build dashboards that analyze conversion and performance, or partner with Revenue Technology to improve Salesforce automation.

  

### **What you’ll be doing**

* Build and operate the global Sales Operations infrastructure that enables SDR leadership to maximize qualified pipeline creation, productivity, conversion, speed-to-lead, data quality, and measurable revenue contribution.
* Establish a strong operating partnership with SDR leaders across regions, brands, and inbound/outbound motions.
* Translate SDR Team priorities into operational requirements, capabilities, processes, and reporting.
* Understand the complete SDR operating lifecycle from lead creation through qualification, meeting conversion, opportunity creation, handoff, disposition, recycle, and re-engagement.
* Identify operational friction that prevents SDRs from spending time on productive selling activity.
* Act as the operational escalation point for issues affecting SDR execution.
* Own lead routing with a focus on speed-to-lead, making sure SDR-sourced opportunities reach the correct salesperson quickly and consistently.
* Monitor routing automation performance and identify exceptions, failures, bottlenecks, and unintended outcomes.
* Investigate misrouted, unassigned, duplicated, stale, or incorrectly prioritized records.
* Work with SDR Leadership to develop and maintain a global SDR KPI framework around activity, productivity, responsiveness, conversion, pipeline/revenue, and operational health.
* Generate detailed breakdowns on recurring schedules at the direction or SDR leadership.
* Own end-of-quarter SDR compensation reporting, ensuring accurate, timely, and auditable attainment data.
* Prepare individual and team performance review data that supports leadership coaching, drawing on Salesforce, Gong, Nooks, and HeyReach.
* Deliver quarterly readouts to SDR and sales leadership, translating data into clear recommendations that improve leadership strategy, resourcing, and targets.

### **What we are looking for**

* 5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Development Operations, or a closely related function within the SaaS, Cloud Connectivity, or high-technology industry.
* Demonstrated experience supporting SDR/BDR organizations with lead routing, lifecycle management, CRM processes, and sales funnel analytics.
* Experience creating and managing Salesforce dashboards, team reporting, and KPI frameworks, including campaign and attribution reporting.
* Familiarity with sales engagement and conversation intelligence tools such as Gong, Nooks, HeyReach, or similar.
* Experience supporting sales compensation processes or producing quarterly comp reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate business requirements into technology/process requirements.
* Experience supporting global direct and channel sales organizations is highly desirable.

### **What we offer**

* Flexible working environments
* Birthday Leave
* Generous study and training allowance + 5 days paid study leave
* Creative, fun, and contemporary workspaces
* A motivated team of industry experts and new talent
* Celebrated success with ‘Legend’ and ‘Kudos’ Awards
* Health and wellness program
* Opportunities for career growth and potential for global intra-company transfers for interested candidates.

86c3c64de3e15d237add.title: Selling Partner Support (SP-S) Specialist, Connect With a Specialist
86c3c64de3e15d237add.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis  
  
This fully remote position is available to candidates residing in most U.S. states, excluding New York and California.  
  
As a Selling Partner Support (SP-S) Specialist, you'll be a crucial part of the Connect with a Specialist (CWS) team, handling complex, high-impact cases through various communication channels. This role demands empathy, critical thinking, and the ability to solve intricate problems without clear-cut solutions. SP-S is dedicated to safeguarding Amazon's global marketplace, protecting all stakeholders from fraud and abuse while providing exceptional support. The CWS team seeks individuals committed to customer satisfaction and skilled in efficiently resolving complex issues. You will be responsible for handling Selling Partner contacts that cannot be resolved through our standard support channels, acting as the expert who dives deeper to identify root causes and deliver resolution. This is not a scripted support role. Much of your development will happen on the job, during live contacts, where you'll encounter issues that don't have a playbook and sellers who need someone willing to dig until they find the answer. The ideal candidate is naturally curious, resilient in the face of ambiguity, and motivated by the challenge of learning something new in every contact. Strong problem-solving skills are essential, but so is the ability to teach yourself, adapt quickly, and turn each case into an opportunity to deepen your expertise.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as a dedicated point of contact for Selling Partners whose issues have not been resolved through standard support channels, managing complex inquiries through phone, chat, and email. Investigate root causes, review prior case history, and develop solutions tailored to each seller's specific situation, including cases where a standard resolution path may not exist. Maintain professionalism throughout all interactions, including contacts that extend beyond your scheduled shift.

  

* Thoroughly document all case research, actions taken, and outcomes through detailed annotations and outbound communications on every contact. When systemic issues or process gaps are identified during case work, escalate them to the Program team with clear documentation of the issue and its impact on sellers.

  

* Manage a steady volume of seller contacts while prioritizing quality of resolution over speed. Use critical thinking and independent research to resolve complex cases, verifying information from tools and knowledge bases rather than accepting outputs at face value. Communicate clearly and thoroughly with sellers through recap emails, outbound follow-ups, and real-time conversations across all channels.

  

* Collaborate with teammates and leadership by sharing case insights, participating in team huddles, and contributing to knowledge-sharing that strengthens the team's collective expertise. Utilize available escalation mechanisms, including andons and leadership escalation paths, when cases require additional support or guidance beyond your scope.

  
A day in the life  
As a Selling Partner Support Specialist, no two days are exactly alike, but here's what you can expect in a typical day:
  
  
You'll log in, review system updates, or process changes, and prepare for incoming contacts. Much of your day will be spent connecting with Selling Partners by phone, chat, and email, resolving everything from quick account questions to complex, multi-layered issues that require deep investigation. You'll adapt your approach in real time, shifting between issue types and channels as contacts come in. When you identify systemic issues or upstream gaps affecting sellers, you'll flag them to our Program team so they can be addressed at scale.
  
  
An important expectation to be aware of: contacts do not always end when your shift does. If you are actively working with a Selling Partner when your scheduled shift ends, the expectation is that you complete that contact before logging off. The Seller experience is the priority, and we do not hand off or disconnect from a seller mid-conversation. This is a standard part of working in a customer service environment, and it happens regularly, some days you'll wrap up right on time; other days a complex case will keep you past your scheduled end of shift.
  
  
This mix of direct support, real-time problem solving, and collaboration with internal teams keeps the role both challenging and rewarding, giving you the chance to make a real impact on the Seller experience every day.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* 1+ years of customer support, or 1+ years of contact center experience
* Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
* Experience with computer troubleshooting, MS Office, and common web browsers, with strong internet and software navigation skills.
* Experience managing phone, chat, and email contacts simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, including the ability to complete active contacts beyond scheduled shift times when needed.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2+ years of experience in customer or account support, with a track record of strengthening relationships and delivering effective support.
* Experience supporting e-commerce sellers, merchants, or small business owners, particularly in navigating platform policies, account issues, or product listing requirements.
* Experience investigating complex issues by reviewing case history, identifying patterns across multiple contacts, and building on prior research rather than starting from scratch.
* Experience working independently in a remote environment, showing self-motivation and a proactive approach to responsibilities and performance expectations.
* Experience exercising critical thinking to resolve complex situations where standard processes don't apply, including the ability to independently verify information from AI tools and knowledge bases rather than accepting outputs at face value.
* Experience identifying systemic issues or process gaps during customer interactions and escalating them to appropriate teams for resolution.
* Ability to adapt to a learning environment where the majority of skill development occurs during live contact work rather than formal training.
* Experience demonstrating empathy with customers while independently researching and tailoring solutions to meet their unique needs, including situations where a standard resolution path may not exist.

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  
  
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The starting pay for this position is listed below. Final starting pay will be based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Starting Day 1 of employment, Amazon offers EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, 401(k) matching. Learn more about our benefits at https://hiring.amazon.com/why-amazon/benefits.

b249f6a0f04ddbf4c852.title: IT Incident Coordinator - Hybrid
b249f6a0f04ddbf4c852.description:
There’s never been a better time to join NJM! With a nationally ranked reputation for outstanding customer service and a history that spans more than a century, NJM is a leading provider of worker’s compensation, automobile, and homeowner’s insurance in New Jersey. It is an exciting time to join NJM as we are expanding into other states.

Become a member of our team and you’ll be part of company who operates for the benefit of its policyholders and is committed to maintaining the highest levels of service. Team members are offered a competitive compensation package and benefits including: a 401k plan, health coverage, a generous paid time off plan, and much more!

NJM’s The Production Support Group's primary objective is to support the NJM Business Units in their efforts to service our insurance customers by providing quick resolutions to their reported application problems while minimizing the impact on vital business functions.

The Product Support Group is seeking an **Incident Coordinator** (can be filled at the Coordinator or Senior role) is responsible for managing and leading complex incident response efforts to ensure timely resolution and minimal disruption to business operations.

  

This role serves as a bridge between tactical execution and strategic oversight, providing expert-level coordination, mentoring junior staff, and contributing to the continuous improvement of incident management processes. The Incident Coordinator collaborates with departments, communicates with stakeholders, and ensures compliance with organizational policies and industry standards.

This role is Hybrid but will require you to be in the office every day for the first several weeks for training. After training you will be able to work from home up to 2 days per week.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Incident Identification:** Monitor systems and processes to identify incidents promptly and validate issues through initial investigation.
* **Response Coordination:** Lead response efforts for high-impact incidents, including assembling technical teams, scheduling and facilitating meetings, and ensuring resolution within defined SLAs.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Maintain clear and effective communication with stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle, including escalation and status reporting.
* **Documentation:** Ensure thorough documentation of incidents, actions taken, and resolutions. Create detailed reports for critical events and maintain incident artifacts.
* **Compliance:** Ensure all incident management activities align with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Analyze incident trends and metrics to identify opportunities for process enhancements and risk mitigation.
* **Mentorship:** Support and mentor junior Incident Coordinators, sharing best practices and providing guidance on incident handling.
* **On-call Support:** Participate in an on-call rotation to support incident response during off-hours and weekends.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 3+ years Demonstrated experience in incident coordination or IT service management
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, including executive-level reporting
* Solid understanding of ITIL processes and incident management frameworks
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and incident tracking tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira)
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to shifting demands
* Experience preparing agendas, incident status reports, and RCA documentation
* H.S. Diploma/GED Required

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Leadership or mentoring experience
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Business Administration, or related field
* Familiarity with insurance industry standards and procedures
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or higher

This role has the flexibility to be filled at the Coordinator or Senior Level. The Salary range is $76,000 - $106,000. Salary is commensurate with experience.

**Legal Disclaimer:**

NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining, and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that reflects the communities we serve.

NJM reserves the right to amend, add, or delete any aspect of this job description at any time based on business needs.

**Compensation:** Salary is commensurate with experience and credentials.

Pay Range: $91,021-$105,768

Eligible full-time employees receive a competitive Total Rewards package, including but not limited to a 401(k) with employer match up to 8% and additional service-based contributions, Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, Life and Disability coverage, generous PTO, Paid Sick Leave, and paid parental leave in addition to state-mandated leave. Employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses.

Legal Disclaimer: NJM is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, retaining and promoting a diverse and inclusive workforce that is fully representative of the diversity that exists in the communities in which we do business.

Overview:

Supervise and coordinate the activities of the Traffic Department to ensure timely receipt and shipment of customers' products and inventory

Responsibilities:

PRIMARY PURPOSE: Supervise and coordinate the activities of the Traffic Department to ensure timely receipt and shipment of customers' products and inventory

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:  
o Supervise the day to day operations of the Traffic Department, including shipping and production coordinators  
o Ensure that customer reports and inventory management and accounting management systems are maintained  
o Manage the overall flow of inbound and outbound material movements  
o Manage and be responsible for customer inventory at the terminal for bulk materials, packaged materials and production and shipping materials  
o Ensure that barge, truck, rail, production and shipping orders from customers are efficiently disseminated to the terminal's operations and fleet departments in a timely manner  
o Distribute daily schedules of barge, truck, rail packaging and shipment orders to the operations department and terminal management. Work closely with operations supervision to ensure efficient completion of all shiping and production orders  
o Track and report shipping and production performance against customer requirements / orders. Ensure that all quality control measures are adhered to at all times  
o Process and create sort maps for vessel cargo prior to vessel discharge sorting material at minimum by Bills of Lading  
o Assist customers and inspectors with resolving questions / problems regarding ivnentory accounting  
o Meet with potential customers to discuss terminal inventory processing operation  
o Work closely with commercial team and terminal management on customer issues or discrepancies  
o Manage and dual verify all customer's order creations have been done property by personnel to insure proper billing.  
o Close out and enter into Galahad Inventory system all plant operation orders generated in the terminal, which requires confirming gauges with inspectors and customer representatives.  
o Allcoate resources and manage variances between measurements to ensure proper inventory accounting  
o Oversee daily inventory levels and production performance against customer requirements / orders. Ensure that all quality control measures are adhered to at all times.  
o Oversee daily inventory levels of bulk and packaged materials at the terminal and ensure records are maintained.  
o Prepare inventory reports for customers daily  
o Work with Terminal Management to meet financial targets established in budgets. Assist with development of annual operating budgets  
o Work with Accounting Manger on end of month close and daily customer research  
o Provide excellent customer service and respond to all customer inquiries / concerns  
o Provide emergency response to customers within a reasonable time frame  
o Ensure proper staffing for daily operations  
o Maintain filing of customer moves, inventory and orders on a daily basis and rotation of boxing files on a monthly basis of all activity for the previous month for all customers, act as a back-up to Traffic personnel in shipping and production. Assist traffic personnel as necessary  
o Provide leadership, training and development to all traffic department employees  
o Ensure that all reports, records and documentation are kept orderly and current. Perform all work in strict accordance to Company policies and procedures  
o Attend daily, weekly and monthly safety meetings  
o Report all accidents, incidents and near misses to management  
o Maintain a positive and professional atmosphere for all employees and visitors  
Other duties as directed or required.

Qualifications:

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

EDUCATION: Four year college degree in a business curriculum preferred or equivalent experience in a traffic, transportation or fleet management role with major responsibility at a bulk liquid terminal or packaging and warehouse facility

EXPERIENCE / SPECIFIC KNOLWEDGE:  
o Knowledge of computer systems to include proficiency in MS Work, Excel, Access and Outlook  
Ability to direct work of other employees

CERTIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:  
o Must have and maintain a valid drivers license.  
Must be able to obtain and maintain a TWIC clearance

COMPETENCIES, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:  
o Must have the ability to monitor and schedule shipping and production orders efficiently and effectively  
o Must be able to track and reconcile inventory of materials  
o Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills, good business acumen and strong organizational and problem solving skills  
o Must have excellent math skills  
o Must be able to recognize a problem or potential problem and take appropriate action  
o Must demonstrate aptitude to execute and maintian necessary records  
Successful candidate subject to pre-employment background check and drug screen upon job offer.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:  
o Include, but are not limited to, walking up and down stairs / ladders, negotiating uneven surfaces, bending, stooping, kneeling, working in inclement weather conditions  
o Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus  
Must meet medical criteria for use of respiratory protective equipment when needed

WORKING CONDITIONS:  
o Must be able to respond to calls on a 24 hour emergency basis  
o Must be able and willing to work extended and/or varied hours as well as weekends and/or holidays, with little or no notice, as necessary  
o Must be willing to shift and/or work excess hours during the week, weekend and/or holidays as necessary  
o Must be able to work with a team, take direction from supervisor, keep required work schedule, focus attention to details and follow safety and work rules.  
Must support and adhere to Company policies and procedures, including, but not limited to Code of Ethics and Business Standards.\

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY: Yes

  
Why Join Kinder Morgan:

Kinder Morgan is a large energy infrastructure company operating in North America. Access to reliable, affordable energy is a critical component for improving lives around the world. We are committed to providing energy transportation and storage services in a safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible manner for the benefit of the people, communities, and businesses we serve.

  

Kinder Morgan provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, gender (including gender identity and expression), sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, family status, status as an individual authorized to work in the U.S., or any other status protected by law.

17c8e07f9712bb5de5fa.title: Customer Service & Events Manager, Catering -Campus Dining
17c8e07f9712bb5de5fa.description:
Overview:

The Catering, Customer Service & Event Manager is responsible for strengthening customer relationships and serving as the primary client contact for all Princeton Catering events. This position leads the process from inquiry through post-event follow-up and collaborates closely with operations, culinary, and administrative teams to ensure exceptional service delivery and financial performance.

This role supports full service, drop-off, and residential catering. The position is accountable for client management, event planning and coordination, including proposal development, contract execution, forecasting, and customer satisfaction.

A cover letter is required for full consideration.

Responsibilities:

**Event Planning and Coordination**

  

* Serve as the primary contact for clients throughout the planning process
* Prepare and present proposals, quotations, and service agreements
* Conduct client consultations and venue tours
* Coordinate all event logistics, including menus, room setups, timelines, rentals, staffing requirements, and special accommodations
* Prepare banquet event orders, contracts, and planning documentation
* Facilitate planning meetings with clients and internal stakeholders
* Manage event revisions and communicate changes effectively to operations and culinary teams
* Conduct post-event follow-up and client satisfaction reviews
* Deliver exceptional customer service and hospitality
* Maintain strong relationships with campus partners and repeat clients
* Resolve client concerns promptly and professionally
* Monitor customer feedback and recommend service improvements
* Support a culture of responsiveness, collaboration, and continuous improvement

**Client Management**

* Develop and maintain relationships with University departments, external clients, conference groups, and campus stakeholders
* Promote Princeton Catering services through outreach, networking, and relationship-building activities
* Host in-house or site events to source new business (event planners, administrative assistants, etc.)

**Technology and Administration**

* Serve as a super-user for catering management software
* Maintain accurate client, event, and revenue records
* Support process improvement initiatives and workflow optimization
* Prepare weekly, monthly, and annual reports
* Ensure compliance with University policies and operational standards

**Financial Management**

* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and financial performance
* Develop accurate event estimates and quotations
* Support annual planning and budgeting processes
* Track revenue performance, trends, and customer activity
* Assist with pricing reviews and revenue optimization initiatives
* Ensure timely invoicing and billing accuracy

Qualifications:

**Essential Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Event Management, or relevant experience
* Minimum 5-7 years of progressively responsible catering, hospitality, conference services, or event management experience
* Experience in high-volume and high-profile catering environments
* Demonstrated success in client retention, and relationship development
* Experience using catering or event management software platforms
* Strong business development and consultative sales skills
* Financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, pricing, and budget analysis
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Strong negotiation and relationship-building capabilities
* Customer-focused with exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to collaborate effectively across operations, culinary, finance, and administrative teams
* Knowledge of food service operations and hospitality practices
* Ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require

**Preferred:**

* Higher education, conference center, hotel, or hospitality experience preferred

d68c5a1617fee21bf207.title: Assistant Operations Manager, Catering Campus Dining
d68c5a1617fee21bf207.description:
Overview:

The Assistant Operations Manager, Catering serves as a visible operational leader, overseeing events across campus and ensuring that all services meet established standards for hospitality, food quality, safety, presentation, and operational excellence. This position works collaboratively with culinary leadership, event stakeholders, and campus partners to execute events ranging from small meetings and receptions to large-scale University functions, including reunions, commencement, and conferences.

A cover letter is required for full consideration.

Responsibilities:

**Event Operations and Execution**

* Coordinate daily catering tasks, ensuring successful execution of events across campus.
* Direct event setup, service delivery, breakdown, and equipment recovery activities.
* Implement plans for transportation logistics, including food delivery schedules, vehicle utilization, routing, and equipment movement.
* Provide administrative support to build staffing and event deployment schedules.
* Monitor productivity, attendance, and adherence to departmental standards.
* Serve as the on-site operational leader for assigned events.
* Ensure event spaces meet established standards for presentation, cleanliness, organization, and hospitality.
* Conduct operational walkthroughs before, during, and after events.
* Troubleshoot operational challenges and implement timely solutions to ensure uninterrupted service.
* Food & Workplace Safety
  + Maintains high standards of food safety and sanitation.
  + Ensures compliance with all state, local, and university food safety, workplace safety, and Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) policies and procedures.
  + Ensures a safe work environment through addressing concerns to eliminate hazards; investigates and reports incidents, enforces safety work rules.

* Respond promptly and professionally to client requests, concerns, and service issues.
* Participate in planning meetings and post-event evaluations.
* Support execution of major University events, including commencements, reunions, alumni programs, conferences, and executive-level functions.
* Maintain event documentation, operational records, and service reports.
* Serve as a key operational contact for clients during event execution.
* Ensure client requirements and event specifications are implemented accurately.
* Gather and communicate client feedback to support continuous improvement efforts.
* Promote a culture of hospitality that reflects Princeton University's commitment to service excellence.

**Supervision, and Team Development**

* Provide direct supervision, guidance, and support to front-line catering associates and student employees.
* Provide training (to include safe and proper equipment handling) and supervision of all staff for high level standards of food safety and sanitation.
* Assist with hiring, onboarding, scheduling, training, and performance management activities.
* Ensure staffing assignments align with event needs and operational priorities.
* Conduct employee evaluations and coaching conversations.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, inclusion, and customer service excellence.
* Ensure compliance with University policies, collective bargaining agreements, and departmental procedures.

**Administrative and Financial Support**

  

* Support inventory management and equipment tracking processes.
* Assist with purchasing, receiving, billing, payroll, and related administrative functions.
* Utilize catering and event management software to maintain accurate event information and staffing schedules.
* Support labor management initiatives and productivity goals.
* Assist in monitoring operational expenses and resource utilization.
* Ensure compliance with all local, state, federal, and University food safety regulations.
* Monitor adherence to Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP), sanitation, workplace safety, and transportation safety standards.
* Conduct routine inspections of equipment, staging areas, and event sites.
* Support fleet management and preventative maintenance activities.
* Promote sustainability initiatives and responsible operational practices.
* Maintain required certifications and training records.

Qualifications:

**Essential Qualifications**

  

* Associate’s degree in hospitality management, Business Administration, Event Management, Food Service Management, or related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of 3 years of progressive experience in catering operations, banquet operations, hospitality management, conference services, hotel food and beverage operations, or higher education dining.
* Experience supervising employees, students, teams, or projects.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple events simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* ServSafe Manager certification or equivalent food safety certification or ability to obtain certification.
* Ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.
* Valid Driver’s License

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Experience in a higher education dining program, conference center, hotel, resort, convention center, or luxury hospitality environment.
* Experience working in a unionized environment.
* Experience utilizing computerized catering, scheduling, or event management systems.
* Experience managing transportation logistics, equipment deployment, or event fleet operations.
* Demonstrated success leading large-scale events with complex operational requirements.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Stand or walk up to 2 hours at one time for a total of 6-8 hours per day;
* Sit for no more than 2 hours during an 8 hour day;
* Lift or carry up to 30 pounds frequently (34 – 66% of the workday);
* Lift or carry up to 50 pounds occasionally (less than 33% of the workday);
* Push or pull using forces up to 50 pounds occasionally (less than 33 % of the workday);
* Frequently use hands for simple grasping, fine manipulation, pushing or pulling with forces up to 30 pounds (34 – 66% of the workday);
* Bend, squat, kneel, climb stairs, reach overhead, lift overhead occasionally (less than 33% of the work day);
* Lift up to 30 pounds in a range of motions from floor to overhead; lift 50 pounds in a range of motions from floor to chest height;
* Work under a range of temperature conditions (e.g., kitchens, walk-in refrigerators and freezers, etc.);
* Possess physical agility, full range of motion, and ability to maintain balance.

e908019e496ef978a0da.title: Customer Experience Manager
e908019e496ef978a0da.description:
**What is Reach Financial?**

Reach Financial is a FinTech platform helping people outsmart debt for good.

We are building innovative products and best-in-class support that enable our customers to take control of their debt and de-mystify their personal finances. Our products and tools empower our customers to turn their financial goals into a reality.

Reach Financial launched in 2015 and has helped our customers pay off over $1 billion in debt. We offer debt consolidation loans and personal loans; together, these markets represent a $1.5T opportunity. In time, we will expand beyond these products to offer solutions for a variety of our customers' personal finance challenges.

We are a fast-growing and fast-paced FinTech startup with the stability of an established firm. You will have a front-row seat at a rapidly growing company innovating the FinTech industry.

**About the Role**

The Customer Experience Manager leads frontline operations, ensuring the effective execution of departmental strategies, achievement of performance goals, and alignment with organizational priorities.

This role is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing Team Leads, overseeing employee performance management, maintaining quality and compliance standards, and optimizing workforce management. The Customer Experience Manager reports directly to the Director of Customer Experience.

**What You Will Do**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop Team Leads and Operations Specialists through biweekly 1:1s.
* Drive the weekly Team Lead meeting on performance trends, process fixes, and training gaps.

* Oversee formal corrective action and performance improvement plans in partnership with People & Culture, including appropriate documentation and escalation.
* Complete Team Lead reviews and support under-performing agent coaching.

**Operations & Workforce Management**

* Own daily operational execution, workload prioritization, scheduling, coverage, PTO, and timecard approvals. Delegate routine monitoring and follow-through to Team Leads.
* Assess demand, capacity, adherence, and coverage risks. Recommend staffing changes to the Director, who retains ownership of staffing forecasts and headcount decisions.
* Resolve second-level customer and operational escalations, document outcomes, and coordinate root-cause remediation with relevant partners.
* Maintain accurate procedures and knowledge resources. Obtain required approvals before publishing policy changes and coordinate training and implementation.

**Quality & Compliance**

* Calibrate QA scoring across the three teams, spot-check calls and emails for required disclosures, UDAAP language, and script adherence per bank partner expectations.
* Coordinate with Compliance, QA, and the Director to investigate exceptions, implement corrective actions, and verify remediation. Escalate significant customer, compliance, or operational risks promptly.

**Reporting & Performance**

* Own departmental KPI performance, including volume, abandon rate, QA, CSAT, AHT, ACW, Speed to Answer and Adherence.
* Validate and consolidate Team Lead reporting, maintain scorecards, and provide the Director with actionable findings, risks, and recommendations. Partner with relevant teams to resolve operational dependencies.
* Own performance improvement for quality, customer treatment, productivity, and employee development measures.
* Validate bonus calculations and supporting data, resolve discrepancies, and submit accurate results to designated recipients within established deadlines.

**What You Should Have**

* At least three years of customer service experience, including two years in a supervisory role, with demonstrated ownership of team performance and operational execution.
* Demonstrated ability to develop leaders, evaluate coaching effectiveness, administer corrective action with People & Culture, and maintain employee engagement.
* Experience in consumer loan servicing, working knowledge of UDAAP, regulatory complaint handling, and bank partner compliance expectations.
* Experience with workforce management and contact center tools (e.g., Amazon Connect, Salesforce, Rippling).
* Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills, including the ability to identify root causes, manage competing priorities, and drive actions to completion.

**What is it like working at Reach Financial?**

Our culture is built around advancing our teams, and we are dedicated to the success and growth of every team member. We believe in retaining a high-performing workforce and we prioritize diversity, intellectual curiosity, and continued learning. Our generous benefits packages reflect that.

We’ve been hard at work perfecting our product for years, and now we’re growing faster than ever before. Our strong foundation and company culture is readily equipped for this growth, and we believe that with the right people, our products will continue to help customers make real changes in their financial lives.

**What benefits will you receive?**

* Healthcare, Life Insurance, 401k Match
* Paid Time Off, Paid 12-week Parental Leave
* Disability (short-term, long-term), Employee Assistance Program
* Spending Accounts (Transit/Parking, Medical, Dependent Care)
* Insurance Discounts (home, auto, pet)

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
75,000 - 95,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

769c4828771ff757d955.title: Manager, Software Support
769c4828771ff757d955.description:
**Who We Are**

Catalis is a leading government Software as a Service (SaaS) and integrated payments provider, powering a wide range of government operations at the municipal, county, state, and federal levels. Our innovative solutions are designed to streamline processes, enhance efficiency, and improve the delivery of government services to the public. At Catalis, we are committed to leveraging technology to make government interactions simpler, faster, and more accessible.

  
  

**The Opportunity**

As a Support Manager at Catalis, you will play a vital role in ensuring the success and satisfaction of our existing clients with the use of our products/services. Your primary focus will be to facilitate resolution of any technical or workflow issues with our products. By understanding their business objectives, aligning our solutions to their needs, facilitating meaningful engagements, validating outcomes, you will drive value delivery and gain referenceable customers for new clients. You will have direct reports in this role that you will mentor, train with best practices on working with our customers for a superior customer experience.

  
  

**What You Will Do**

This role includes supporting multiple product lines with staff located both locally and remotely. He/she will be responsible for leading and directing a team of software support analysts who support direct client interactions. This leader will have a history of demonstrated strength in multi-site customer service leadership, team leadership, process deployment, leveraging technology in Customer Service, Salesforce CRM, and process improvement.

  
  

The Support Manager provides overall direction and guidance for all customer service people, systems, and workflows. This includes technical expertise and managing a growing customer service team; designing and optimizing customer service process workflows; designing and implementing programs to optimize customer service efficiencies; and managing CRM reporting tools.

  
  

The Support Manager will demonstrate superior leadership skills, work well with a team, work with all levels of management, and can work independently with little or no supervision. The Support Manager must have superior decision-making skills, problem-solving skills, and conflict-management abilities. He/she must have a have deep experience in CRM, reporting, process improvement, and be able to design programs that will drive success through distribution

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Lead multi-site customer service organization, including day to day leadership, talent management, and staffing.
* Support the Operations teams by providing process improvement, measurement, tracking and analytics of support analyst relevant to their functional areas
* Refine customer services processes, build and deliver analysis and reports on customer service performance with reporting and dashboards
* Drive increased productivity by leading process changes and refinement
* Track and analyze key customer success metrics for use in internal and external review processes
* Own the end-to-end process of tracking the customer service metrics and delivering regular insights to the business; define and deliver techniques to improve customer service performance.
* Assist with on-boarding and training new talent
* Maintain regular check-ins with the Director of Customer Support.
* Be customer-centric

  

Requirements

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree preferred
* >3 years proven success in Customer Service role
* Excellent growth performance track record and employee management skills
* Experience building process and programs.
* Deep customer service process knowledge and history of successful installation of process
* Background in a fast-paced technology environment is necessary
* Ability to develop and maintain strong working relationships with all levels of staff, customers, and partners
* Strong administrative, management and personnel recruitment and retainment skills
* Demonstrated comfort making decisions in a fast-paced environment
* Adaptable to change and helping others through change management practices

**What we Offer**

* A dynamic and supportive work environment in a mission driven organization
* Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, vision insurance
* Unlimited PTO (paid time off)
* HSA and FSA options
* 401(k) plan with matching contributions
* Paid parental leave
* ABLE matching contributions for the disability community
* Employer paid short term and long-term disability insurance and group term life insurance
* Financial and legal assistance through our EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
* Opportunities for personal development and career advancement with free access to unlimited courses via Udemy
* The chance to make a significant impact on the delivery of government services and the lives of citizens

**EEO Statement**

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to an inclusive environment for all. All candidates will be considered based on qualifications, merit, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, non-qualifying mental or physical disability, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

0cab67b247a2a7d84bda.title: Customer Success Manager - Remote
0cab67b247a2a7d84bda.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

**About the Role**

Steer is looking for a Customer Success Manager to build strong relationships with automotive shop owners and managers and help them get measurable value from our products. You will own an assigned portfolio, guide customers after onboarding, address risks early, and identify opportunities to support their growth. This role combines proactive account management with responsive, dependable customer communication.  
  
**Compensation: $80,000 - $90,000 base + 15% bonus.**

**You Are**

* **A Relationship Builder:** You are a proactive account owner who builds deep trust with shop owners, managers, and day-to-day operational contacts.
* **Comfortable Managing a Portfolio:** You thrive when balancing customer needs, competing priorities, and proactive outreach across a varied book of business.
* **A Structure Builder:** You are energized by the "grey area" and enjoy creating order. You want to help improve the customer success playbook while consistently executing on customer commitments.
* **Commercially Minded & Composed:** You are highly organized, focused on driving business value, and able to remain calm under pressure while balancing customer advocacy with internal capacity.

**You Will**

* **Own the Customer Lifecycle:** Manage ongoing customer relationships after onboarding, including proactive check-ins, business reviews, renewal readiness, and expansion identification.
* **Strengthen the CS Playbook:** Help improve how Steer proactively supports customers through consistent touchpoints, clear follow-up, and repeatable account management practices.
* **Champion Cross-Functional Alignment:** Partner with Support, Onboarding, Product, Sales, and RevOps to resolve customer issues and translate feedback into clear internal next steps.
* **Mitigate Risk & Drive Growth:** Maintain visibility into account health, identify revenue risks early, and take action to improve retention and uncover relevant expansion opportunities.
* **Ensure Consistent Execution:** Lead smooth onboarding transitions, help customers connect product capabilities to their goals, and keep account records and commitments current. Respond promptly and keep customers informed through resolution.

**You Have**

***Must Have***

* **Customer Relationship Experience:** 2+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or a comparable customer-facing role, with ownership of ongoing customer relationships.
* **Commercial Acumen:** A track record of supporting customer retention and identifying growth opportunities. You can connect product value to customer business goals and navigate conversations about risk, renewals, and expansion.
* **Clear Communication & Follow-Through:** Strong presentation, organization, and relationship skills, with the ability to lead productive customer conversations, set clear expectations, and consistently deliver on commitments.
* **Lifecycle Ownership:** Experience managing post-sale customer needs, including adoption, account health, issue resolution, and coordination across internal teams.

***Nice to Have***

* **Industry Experience:** Familiarity with automotive, franchise, or Multi-Shop Operator (MSO) business models.
* **CS Ecosystem Tech:** Experience using HubSpot, Slack, Google Workspace, or dedicated Customer Success platforms.
* **Process Improvement:** Experience supporting SMB or mid-market SaaS customers, improving customer onboarding or engagement processes, or working with marketing SaaS, integrations, or business phone products.

  

#### 

**Interview Process:**

1. Recruiting screen - 20 min  
2. Hiring manager interview - 45 min  
3. Assignment/Case Study - 1hr  
4. Problem Solving Exercise - 1hr  
5. Reference check

  

**We Offer**

* 100% remote work environment
* Medical, Dental and Vision insurance within 30 days
* 100% employer-paid medical insurance
* Equity package
* Flexible PTO with 15 days minimum
* Generous Parental Leave
* FSA and HSA options
* 401(k)
* Growth & Wellness Stipend
* WFH Equipment
* Chance to work with the latest technology
* A collaborative, high ownership culture
* Opportunities for development and career growth

**Why Join Steer?**  
  
At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you'll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.  
  
  
  
  
We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

8521d9dac021d2df8a33.title: Customer Value Manager
8521d9dac021d2df8a33.description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

  

**Job Introduction:**
  
  
The Customer Success Manager is responsible for managing relationships with assigned customers to ensure adoption, satisfaction, and retention of the company’s solutions. This role serves as the primary point of contact for day-to-day engagement, helping customers achieve value from their investment while identifying opportunities for growth. The Customer Success Manager partners with Sales, Product, and Support teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
  
  

* Manage a portfolio of customer accounts, building strong relationships with key stakeholders.
* Develop success plans to ensure customers achieve desired outcomes with company solutions.
* Monitor account health metrics, identify risks, and proactively address adoption challenges.
* Conduct regular check-ins and business reviews with customers to share insights and progress.
* Collaborate with Sales on renewals and expansion opportunities.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to provide customer feedback and advocate for enhancements.
* Resolve escalated issues by coordinating with cross-functional teams.
* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, issues, and progress in CRM systems.
* Contribute to the development of customer success best practices and playbooks.

  
**Basic Qualifications:**
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field; equivalent experience considered.
* 5–7 years of experience in customer success, account management, or related role.
* Strong relationship-building and communication skills with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Experience managing customer portfolios in a SaaS or technology environment.
* Proficiency with CRM and customer success platforms (Salesforce, Gainsight, or equivalent).
* Ability to analyze customer data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Strong problem-solving and organizational skills.
* Customer-focused mindset with the ability to manage competing priorities.

  
  

**Perks & Benefits**
--------------------

  

* Competitive compensation and generous stock options
* 100% employer-paid top-of-the-line medical, dental and vision coverage
* Great benefits including unlimited PTO, parental leave and free snacks and beverages
* The opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley’s most dominant and successful companies
* Be part of an early stage, hyper-growth start-up with the opportunity to grow and prosper
* Work on the latest and coolest technologies – everything is home-grown and built ground-up
* A dynamic work environment with a strong sense of community and collaboration
* The open and transparent culture that encourages innovation, rewards performance and discourages hierarchy
* Exciting opportunities for career growth and development

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby.**

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!

Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

500a3ce5076259e7bee0.title: Order Resolution Program Manager
500a3ce5076259e7bee0.description:
**Positition:**

The Order Resolution Program Manager builds and leads the Order Resolution Program (ORP), a national program that helps ensure patients receive the testing their physicians have ordered. When an order encounters a barrier, such as an unreachable patient, an incorrect phone number, a patient with unanswered questions about their test, or a step that requires clinic involvement, this role makes sure the right people take the right action so care is not delayed. Many of these patients are navigating a cancer diagnosis, and the program exists to support them and the Patient Coordinators who care for them.

As the *program's founding owner*, the Program Manager exercises independent judgment to assess the current landscape, resolve complex cases directly, and determine what the program needs to succeed, including whether and how to expand the team. The role is hands-on by design: the Program Manager works open cases alongside Patient Coordinators to understand where and why orders stall, then uses that firsthand insight and program data to set strategy, define standards, and guide leadership decisions.

The Program Manager partners across Patient Services, Territory Managers, Clinical Oncology Specialists, Patient Coordinators, Inside Sales Managers, Regional Directors, and Operations Managers, earning alignment through expertise and sound judgment rather than direct authority.

  

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Program Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the Order Resolution Program end-to-end across all national regions, independently assessing the current landscape, including case volume, root causes, regional variation, and existing workflows, to determine where patient orders are most at risk of delay.
* Develop a data-supported program roadmap and staffing recommendation for Patient Services leadership, including headcount requirements, staffing structure, timeline, and whether process or tooling solutions would better serve patients.
* Define the program operating model, including case ownership, escalation criteria, service timelines, handoff protocols, and quality standards, and adjust it as the program matures.
* Lead the design of the team structure, role definitions, hiring profile, onboarding, and performance expectations for future team members.

**Case Resolution & Patient Care Support**

* Exercise independent judgment to evaluate open ORP cases, determine the root cause of each barrier, and develop a tailored resolution strategy that accounts for the clinical context, the patient's circumstances, and available resources.
* Work complex and high-priority cases directly, including researching LIMS, paper orders, and patient outreach tools to locate missing or updated contact information, and decide whether a case calls for administrative resolution, clinic education or engagement, or escalation.
* Partner with Patient Coordinators to support patient outreach, providing guidance on how to approach each case and, where appropriate, connecting with patients directly so that questions about their orders are answered and care can move forward.
* Determine when to escalate a case to the clinic, engage the field team, or close it, and document the rationale so any subsequent owner can continue seamlessly.
* Maintain a real-time view of all open cases, including status, owner, next action, and age, and follow up consistently to confirm actions are completed and patients are not left waiting.

**Analytics & Performance Reporting**

* Design, build, and maintain the ORP reporting infrastructure, including dashboards, KPI scorecards, and regional trend analysis, and define the metrics used to measure program success.
* Report regularly to Patient Services leadership on case volume, resolution rates, time to resolution, and order completion outcomes, translating data into clear insights about what is working, what is not, and what should change.
* Analyze recurring barriers, such as common reasons patients cannot be reached or questions that arise repeatedly, and develop recommendations that reduce the number of patients whose orders require intervention in the first place.

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Process Improvement**

* Partner with Territory Managers, Clinical Oncology Specialists, Associate Clinical Oncology Specialists, and Patient Coordinators to set clear expectations, communicate promptly, and share accountability on every open case.
* Partner with Inside Sales Managers, Regional Directors, and Operations Managers to align program priorities, resolve regional barriers, and ensure teams understand their role in supporting patient orders.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for ORP, providing guidance and consultation to field and operations partners and developing best practices, training, and standard work that can be adopted nationally.
* Identify systemic process gaps and bring structured, data-backed recommendations to leadership, including changes to workflows, status definitions, tooling, and cross-team handoffs, with the patient experience as the guiding lens.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, life sciences, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience in a role requiring independent judgment, program ownership, and decision-making in a healthcare or clinical operations environment.
* 5 or more years of experience in healthcare operations, patient services, program or project management, or a comparable environment, with demonstrated ownership of a program, workflow, or initiative from assessment through execution.
* Demonstrated ability to assess a complex operating landscape, identify root causes, and develop and present a data-supported recommendation, including resourcing and staffing needs, to senior leadership.
* Proven ability to independently assess multi-variable situations and determine the appropriate course of action without direct supervision, particularly in patient-facing or clinically sensitive contexts.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and drive accountability across cross-functional teams, including field, sales, and operations leaders, without direct authority.
* Strong analytical capability, including building performance reporting, interpreting trends, and communicating findings clearly to leadership; advanced MS Excel or equivalent skills required.
* Experience in a call center, patient outreach, or high-volume case management environment (inbound and outbound).
* Proficiency in CRM platforms, case tracking systems, and data tools; familiarity with skip tracing tools and LIMS is a strong plus.
* Prior experience leading, coaching, or building a team is preferred. Background in patient coordination or another patient-facing healthcare role is strongly preferred.

  

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

**Technical**

* Program and project management expertise, including scoping, planning, prioritization, milestone tracking, and stakeholder management.
* Specialized knowledge of healthcare operations, patient services workflows, and clinical coordination sufficient to evaluate case scenarios and develop resolution strategies without relying on standardized scripts.
* Advanced proficiency in CRM platforms, case tracking systems, and reporting tools, with the ability to design KPI dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into program performance and patient order outcomes.
* Strong quantitative skills, including comfort working with large data sets to identify trends, build business cases, and model staffing and capacity needs.
* Experience with skip tracing tools and multi-database research methods, and with process documentation and standard operating procedure development.

**Behavioral**

* Exercises sound, independent judgment consistently, treating each case and each program decision as a situation requiring individualized analysis.
* Builds before being asked: sees what a new program needs, takes ownership of the decision, and moves forward without waiting to be told something is off track.
* Balances urgency and care: moves quickly because patients are waiting, and makes thoughtful decisions because the stakes are real.
* Thinks like a program owner and acts like a teammate: comfortable working individual cases to learn the work, and equally comfortable stepping back to set strategy and advise leadership.
* Earns credibility with cross-functional partners through expertise, clear communication, and follow-through, and uses it to drive action across teams they do not directly control.
* Coaches and develops others, and is ready to build and lead a team as the program grows.

  

**Physical Demands & Work Environment:**

* This is a primarily remote position. Occasional on-site attendance may be required for planning sessions, leadership reviews, or business needs.
* Duties are performed in a home office or professional office setting and require the ability to use a computer keyboard, communicate over the telephone, and read printed and digital material.
* This role may require working outside standard business hours at times to address time-sensitive case situations or program needs.

**Travel:**

Minimal travel required. Occasional travel (estimated less than 15%) may be required for national leadership meetings, regional business reviews, or planning sessions.

**OUR OPPORTUNITY**

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you'll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

*If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.*

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.
