0bac064d3ebaec9a1bf6.title: Project Stakeholder Engagement Coordinator
0bac064d3ebaec9a1bf6.description:
Pathways 2 Solutions, Inc. (Pathways) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business helping government and commercial clients turn complex challenges into practical solutions. Our capabilities span strategic communications, technology, training, program management, and organizational improvement. We bring together experienced professionals who combine creative thinking with disciplined execution to help clients achieve measurable results.  
We help clients develop programs, introduce new technologies, engage stakeholders, and equip people with the knowledge and resources to succeed. Our work with the Department of Veterans Affairs supports initiatives that improve the Veteran experience. We welcome professionals who bring sound judgment, fresh ideas, and a commitment to delivering useful, reliable work.

**Position Overview**
=====================

The Project Stakeholder Engagement Coordinator supports enterprise-level outreach and engagement for the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs. The role coordinates in-person, virtual, and hybrid activities that help Veterans, family members, caregivers, VA clinicians, staff, leaders, and other stakeholders understand and use connected care resources.  
The Project Stakeholder Engagement Coordinator carries out the day-to-day execution of DRHCI project stakeholder engagements under the direction of the Stakeholder Engagement Enterprise Lead. This position runs partner outreach and meeting logistics, operates the recurring process for collecting frontline challenges, builds and maintains the searchable problem repository, prepares engagement materials, plans and runs engagement events, and tracks and reports engagement activity for the project and supports strategy, senior relationships, informs designs governance, and executes what the Lead designs.  
The Coordinator combines audience and event research, stakeholder coordination, event logistics, outreach delivery, and feedback analysis. Working with contractor leadership, designated VA stakeholders, and event partners, the Coordinator provides a consistent, welcoming, accessible experience and brings stakeholder insights back to the teams responsible for program improvements.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* Maintains the integrated engagement calendar and tracker, and drafts and updates sections of the DRHCI Stakeholder Engagement Plan under the Lead's direction.
* Conducts day-to-day outreach to industry partners, VSOs, academic institutions, and local health organizations: schedules meetings and workshops, prepares agendas and materials, records outcomes, follows up on actions, and maintains stakeholder contact lists.
* Drafts materials for national calls that showcase projects, gauge demand, and gather feedback, along with cheat sheets and one-pagers, for Lead approval and in coordination with the Communications Specialist.
* Operates the recurring frontline-challenge process: issues requests to Innovation Specialists and facilities, logs submissions, validates them with submitters, tracks follow-up, and keeps submitted needs current.
* Builds, populates, tags, and maintains the searchable repository of frontline problems according to the Lead's governance rules, aligns problems with proposed or existing vendor solutions, and keeps entries current.
* Maintains the VSO feedback loop: records VSO-identified problems, tracks their status, and drafts updates on how problems are being addressed for Lead approval.
* Prepares and runs logistics for engagement with the field-based Innovation Specialists on the Lead's cadence, including materials, scheduling, and follow-up.
* Plans and runs logistics for hackathons, innovation fairs, and networking events: registration, venue or virtual platform, agenda, materials, travel, and post-event follow-up.
* Tracks engagement and socialization activity, compiles participation, interaction, and feedback data, and drafts the Stakeholder Engagement Impact Report for Lead review.
* Maintains stakeholder engagement SOPs, toolkits, templates, checklists, and lessons learned in approved repositories.
* Coordinates with the Communications Specialist so engagement materials carry consistent messaging, and with the Project Stakeholder Engagement Coordinator so project-level insight feeds the enterprise repository.
* Coordinates with technical, data, and privacy staff to obtain accurate technical content for engagement materials. Leadership Expectations

This position has no formal supervisory responsibility. The Coordinator is expected to take ownership of assigned engagements, establish trust quickly, anticipate logistical challenges, and communicate clearly with participants, partners, and leadership.  
The role may coordinate the activities of assigned event personnel, subcontractor representatives, or local support staff. Decisions involving additional spending, changes in scope, staffing commitments, or public messaging must follow established approval processes.  
For assigned DRHCI activities, the Coordinator maintains the enterprise engagement approach and frontline problem repository in coordination with the designated stakeholder engagement lead. The role coordinates contributions from field staff, project teams, and communications colleagues without supervisory authority over them.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Three or more years in stakeholder engagement, outreach, partnership coordination, or comparable external-facing program work.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating stakeholder outreach and meetings across organizations with no shared reporting line.
* Experience planning and running convening events (workshops, conferences, fairs, or comparable), including logistics, agenda, and follow-through.
* Experience building and maintaining a tracked repository or database with consistent tagging and ownership, using SharePoint, Teams, or comparable platforms.
* Experience gathering stakeholder feedback and preparing concise summaries, recommendations, or after-action reports.
* Strong written communication, including the ability to produce short, practical materials for busy field staff rather than long formal documents.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, webinar platforms, and presentation technology.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment, and to travel within the United States, including overnight trips and occasional early morning, evening, or weekend activities.
* Ability to obtain a VA background investigation or public trust determination.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience supporting VA, another federal healthcare organization, or Veteran-facing programs.
* Experience working with Veterans Service Organizations or comparable advocacy and beneficiary organizations.
* Experience supporting VA, VHA, or other federal health programs.
* Experience with innovation community events such as hackathons, fairs, or workshops.
* Experience measuring and reporting engagement outcomes rather than activity counts.
* Experience in digital health, telehealth, or technology adoption.
* Familiarity with federal plain-language practices and Section 508 accessibility.

**Credentials and VA Experience**
=================================

No professional certification or prior VA experience is required.  
Relevant training or certification in implementation science, project management, change management, human-centered design, Lean Six Sigma, or quality improvement is preferred.

**Location Remote Work and Travel**
===================================

Pathways is a fully remote government contracting organization. At this time, applicants must reside and perform their remote work in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Mississippi, North Carolina, Tennessee, or Texas, with business travel to approved event locations as required.  
Employees must maintain a professional, secure remote workspace, reliable high-speed internet, and availability during established client and team working hours, generally aligned with Eastern Time unless otherwise approved.  
The anticipated event schedule is approximately 10–15in-person events annually, with summer generally the busiest period. Events may require overnight travel and additional time for setup and breakdown. Actual travel frequency and duration depend on approved client priorities, event locations, and staffing needs. Additional events may be assigned as requirements evolve.

**Work Environment and Physical Requirements**
==============================================

Remote work involves extended computer use and participation in virtual meetings. Event assignments may involve prolonged standing and walking, booth setup and breakdown, and lifting or moving exhibit equipment, shipping cases, and boxed materials weighing up to 40 pounds.  
Event staff may need to transport materials between shipping or pickup areas, vehicles, storage locations, and exhibit booths, including across large conference facilities. These duties may be performed with appropriate handling equipment, team assistance, or reasonable accommodation.  
Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.

**Compensation and Benefits**
=============================

The anticipated annual hiring range is $120,000–$140,000. Actual compensation will reflect relevant experience, education, specialized expertise, credentials, work location, internal equity, and applicable contract and funding parameters.  
Pathways offers a collaborative, family-oriented workplace, opportunities for professional growth, and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan; paid time off; and other benefits available under applicable company plans and policies.

**Employment Requirements and Equal Opportunity**
=================================================

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. Pathways is currently unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of an employment visa. Employment may be contingent on contract award, client approval, and satisfaction of applicable federal suitability, background, privacy, security, and training requirements.  
Pathways is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to an inclusive, safe, healthy, and productive workplace. Women, minorities, Veterans, and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply.  
Applicants who require assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process because of a disability or medical condition may contact Terri Baxter, HR Director, at terri.baxter@pw2s.com.

Pathways 2 Solutions Inc. is dedicated to providing equal opportunity for individuals of all abilities. If you require assistance or need accommodation at any stage of the application process because of a disability or medical condition, please feel free to email terri.baxter@pw2s.com.  
  
Pathways has a policy of maintaining a workplace free of drugs and alcohol. Pathways ensures a safe, healthy, and productive work environment for its employees and others. All applicants are advised that full compliance with this policy is a condition of employment at Pathways.  
  
Applicants must have authorization to work for any employer in the United States. We are currently unable to sponsor or to take over sponsorship of an employment visa.  
  
Pathways is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We invite applications from all interested individuals, including veterans and persons with disabilities.

87200c6b2bc53aab9e0c.description:
**About the team**
------------------

Zillow’s Workforce Management team helps our customer-facing teams deliver reliable, efficient service to customers and partners. We connect workforce planning with day-to-day operations, aligning staffing and resources with service needs and business priorities. Through close collaboration with operations teams, we improve resource utilization, strengthen the customer experience, and build workforce practices that can scale with the business.

**About the role**
------------------

As Manager, Workforce Planning, you’ll lead a team of resource planning analysts to help achieve service-level and operational efficiency goals. You’ll shape workforce planning strategies, optimize staffing resources, and develop a team structure built for agility and scale.

Partnering across operations, you’ll translate data into actionable recommendations, strengthen workforce planning practices, and develop the team’s skills and expertise. Your work will help improve customer and partner experiences while positioning workforce planning as a trusted source of insight across the organization.

You will get to:

* Lead and develop a team of analysts by setting meaningful goals and providing coaching that advances their skills, expertise, and business understanding.
* Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making, innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Develop and execute a resource planning strategy that improves staffing utilization and cost efficiency while supporting positive customer and partner experiences.
* Support consistent service-level performance by providing partners with accurate, timely, and actionable insights for strategic and tactical decisions.
* Build relationships with internal and external partners, communicate workforce planning recommendations, and demonstrate their business value.
* Improve workforce planning tools, including the administration and optimization of the Aspect workforce management platform, to strengthen operational effectiveness.
* Establish operating procedures, expand effective use of workforce management tools, and incorporate automation and AI-assisted processes in workforce management operations

U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $97,400.00 - $155,600.00 annually. In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $92,600.00 - $147,800.00 annually. **Who you are**

* An experienced workforce planning professional with demonstrated expertise and a track record of delivering results.
* Bring 8+ years of leadership experience in workforce planning or contact center operations.

* Have a track record of leading remote teams effectively and fostering collaboration in a distributed work environment.
* Have experience implementing workforce planning programs and administering workforce management platforms.
* Communicate clearly and persuasively, with the ability to present recommendations and influence partners at multiple levels.
* Bring advanced analytical and reporting skills and can work independently in ambiguous, evolving environments.
Are able to travel when appropriate to attend meetings and business reviews.  

Preferred Qualifications

* Leadership experience focused on resource management and real-time operations.
* Experience administering Alvaria/Aspect workforce management platforms.

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.*

3a066a83d3d939285d63.title: Senior Program Manager - Incident Coordinator
3a066a83d3d939285d63.description:
About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.  
Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States  
Overview:

GitHub is seeking an experienced and customer-focused Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator to independently coordinate complex, high-risk and business-critical customer situations within the Incident Coordination team’s remit.

Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator provides leadership during urgent customer-impacting incidents, creating clarity in ambiguous situations, establishing ownership and aligning Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Reliability Engineering, Customer Success and other stakeholders around a clear path forward.

This role requires excellent judgement, composure and the ability to influence without direct authority. The Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator must be able to manage several competing workstreams, make explicit prioritization decisions and communicate complex technical situations clearly to customers, senior leaders and technical stakeholders.

The role extends beyond coordinating individual incidents. Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinators use evidence from incidents and escalations to identify recurring risks, recommend improvements and deliver agreed changes within the incident coordination remit. They partner with accountable teams on broader product, support-process and customer-experience improvements.

Success is measured through effective incident coordination, sound prioritisation, timely and accurate customer communication, reliable handovers and follow-through on agreed actions. The role also contributes to shared improvements that reduce repeat customer impact, avoidable urgent demand and preventable executive escalations.

Responsibilities:

Strategic incident leadership

* Independently lead complex, high-risk customer incidents, prioritising by impact, urgency and risk.

* Create clarity and momentum when cause, ownership, recovery path or customer outcome is uncertain.

* Own coordination, communication, action tracking and handovers across the incident lifecycle.

* Establish clear technical ownership and coordinate workstreams, decisions, risks, dependencies and next steps. Engineering and Support remain accountable for technical decisions, remediation and resource commitments.

* Exercise sound judgement, challenge assumptions and adapt the response as evidence changes.

* Make competing priorities and trade-offs explicit, engaging specialist support or accountable leaders when needed.

Cross-functional leadership and influence

* Bring together the required internal teams and Microsoft partners to coordinate an effective response.

* Align stakeholders with different priorities, responsibilities and perspectives.

* Influence technical owners, senior stakeholders and partners without relying on direct authority.

* Resolve unclear ownership, identify alternative paths and escalate proportionately while maintaining productive relationships.

* Drive timely decisions, confirm accountable owners and track actions, risks and dependencies to completion.

* Act as a trusted operational adviser during executive-visible and high-pressure situations.

Customer and executive communication

* Translate complex technical information into concise, accurate and business-relevant updates.

* Separate confirmed facts from hypotheses, risks and unknowns.

* Set an effective communication cadence and tailor detail to each audience.

* Avoid speculation, unsupported recovery estimates and unrealistic commitments.

* Provide coordination and clarity on customer calls, managing expectations and supporting de-escalation.

* Lead difficult conversations while balancing customer advocacy with technical and operational constraints.

* Maintain stakeholder confidence while protecting responders from unnecessary distraction.

Incident intelligence and repeat-failure reduction

* Identify recurring patterns and systemic risks across incidents, customers, products and processes.

* Use evidence to define clear problems, insights and recommendations.

* Lead post-incident reviews focused on ownership, prevention and operational improvement.

* Agree corrective and preventative actions, owners and expected outcomes with accountable teams.

* Track significant actions to completion, acceptance or formal disposition, escalating stalled or unowned risks.

* Evaluate whether improvements reduce repeat incidents, customer impact and avoidable escalations.

Organisational and operational improvement

* Lead incident-coordination improvement projects and partner with accountable teams to implement agreed changes.

* Use incident and customer-impact evidence to influence product, engineering and operational priorities.

* Improve coordination processes, tooling, ownership, communication, handovers and disengagement practices.

* Identify automation and AI opportunities that increase consistency, effectiveness and scale.

* Develop outcome measures that show customer impact, operational risk and improvement progress.

* Create reusable operating practices, clarify ownership and share learning with partner teams.

Capability building

* Build and apply expertise across incident workflows and relevant product areas to clarify customer impact and support investigation.

* Train and onboard coordinators, sharing judgement and learning from complex incidents.

* Review incident communications, handovers and escalations to improve quality and consistency.

* Create reusable playbooks, standards and guidance that strengthen team capability without creating dependency on individuals.

* Share learning with Support and partner teams to improve incident readiness and customer engagement.

* Partner with Engineering to document and follow up on incident-driven bugs and feature requests, communicating relevant outcomes to customers and responders.

Qualifications:

* 7+ years experience in technical customer support, technical writing, system administration, or related roles

  + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field AND 5+ years experience in technical customer support, technical writing, system administration, or related roles
  + OR equivalent experience.

* Experience leading complex, high-impact incidents across multiple teams and stakeholder groups, creating clarity and momentum in ambiguous or rapidly changing situations.

* Experience making and defending difficult prioritization decisions based on customer impact, business and technical risk, entitlement, and available capacity.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including managing difficult customer and stakeholder conversations and communicating complex situations to senior leaders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading high-profile, executive-visible customer incidents or escalations in a global technology organisation.

* Experience partnering across Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, Security, Communications, and account teams.

* Experience identifying recurring incident patterns and using data and evidence to drive preventative, product, engineering, or operational improvements.

9824534568da50b6d557.description:
**Position:** Store Manager
  
**Department:** Donated Goods Retail  
**Reports to:** Retail District Director  
**Status:** Exempt

Goodwill Keystone Area is committed to creating a culture of belonging where all people feel respected and valued. This is because we celebrate the diversity of thought, the richness of the human experience and the desire to reflect the communities we serve.

**Summary**  
Responsible for the management of a Goodwill store. Plan, coordinate, and direct the daily activities related to its successful operation and the achievement ensuring that the organization goals and objectives are accomplished. Provides leadership and ensures compliance to standards, financial performance, productivity and accountability.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Responsible for hiring, orientation, training, development, coaching, and termination of store staff. Ensures job descriptions are maintained and updated as well as establishes performance criteria. Promotes and models a team-based approach among staff and works across departments to support all aspects of employment at Goodwill. Ensures the proper coordination of clients assigned to the store. Communicates problems and concerns with Retail District Director (RDD) and/or Human Resources representative.
* Oversees and manages operations to ensure the following but not limited to:
  + Goodwill policies and procedures are communicated and enforced.
  + Sufficient daily inventory of raw donations to meet all store production goals.
  + Staff schedules in line with store staffing model and budgeting parameters.
  + Donor doors are open and able to accept donations during all business hours.
  + Appropriate and consistent use of SAP Warehouse Management System (WMS) to accurately account for and track containers by type of product (i.e. raw, processed, 2nd sort, etc.). Meet all system compliance standards.
  + Achievement of daily/weekly production and sales goals and utilization of SITW reports to continually monitor employees’ production against goals; adjusts production and other operational practices while maintaining efficiencies to meet goals by following all established standards and guidelines.
  + Identify ways to improve backroom operations, front end retail sales and other aspects of operations and discuss with senior management.
  + Know and understand all key metrics related to the store; work with RDD on developing enhance data analysis skills.
  + Maximize used goods processing through the proper application of GKA established techniques, including:
    - Sorting
    - Preparing and pricing items for sale
    - Meeting and exceeding production goals on a consistent basis
    - Consistent rotation of all merchandise in accordance with store rotation schedule.
    - Submission of high quality donations to Ecommerce.
    - Adhere to all guidelines for New Goods inventory tracking and management.
* Oversees all visual merchandising, cleanliness and organization of the sales floor to promote an attractive and convenient layout; ensures appropriate and timely use of all branded marketing materials and signage. This includes but is not limited to:
  + Maintain odor control of store.
  + Cash registers and rest rooms are in proper working order.
  + Maintain appearance of all areas of building exterior and landscape.
  + Maintain processing area appearance, housekeeping and work environment.
  + Identify structural concerns to discuss with the landlord and notify facilities team of all repairs and maintenance needs of the facility.
* Ensures that all paperwork is completed in an accurate and timely fashion to include, but not be limited to: new hire intake packet; payroll and production records, audit forms; payroll status and termination paperwork; and performance appraisals, etc.
* Serves as a role model, promotes a supportive culture, and ensures that store staff represent Goodwill in a positive manner by providing excellent customer service at all times both external and internal customers (i.e. coworkers, donors, shoppers).
* Ensures compliance with all asset protection policies and procedures; and proper cash handling including enforcement of cash register procedures and submission of required reports. Reports concerns and problems to RDD and Loss Prevention Department.
* Promotes an environment of workplace safety by training and informing others regarding safety standards/precautions. Monitors safety and takes corrective action. Assures that regulatory safety requirements are adhered to.
* Assists in the development of the annual budget. Effectively and efficiently manage the store budget including maintaining position control, achieving processing goals, generating revenue and controlling expenses. Tracks variances to budget and communicates reasons for variances to RDD.
* Supports and promotes organizational programs and special events, as required.
* Promotes an environment of workplace safety by training and informing others regarding safety standards/precautions. Monitors safety and takes corrective action. Assures that regulatory safety requirements are adhered to.
* Communicates progress, problems, and concerns to the Retail District Director.

**Job Summary**

The Agency Operations Manager serves as the critical link between Agency Service Delivery and Billing Operations. You will own the post-sale agency (B2G/B2B) lifecycle (Order-to-Cash) by overseeing agency vendorization, onboarding, order processing, activation, billing, collections, and renewals while simultaneously supporting agency partners.

This role’s primary mandate is to build a scalable agency operations engine that improves activation speed, revenue collection, and agency satisfaction while supporting rapid growth.

You will lead a high-performing operational team responsible for delivering reliable, compliant, and cost-efficient service across agency accounts.

The ideal candidate is a mission-driven leader who is equally comfortable coaching teams, navigating state Medicaid waiver programs, and analyzing operational and revenue performance metrics. This is a highly hands-on operational leadership role suited for a builder who enjoys balancing strategic process improvement with day-to-day operational execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

Adapt the relevant process for the different types of partners - B2G state waiver funding programs, and other B2B types of verticals (law enforcement, schools, assistive living facilities, non-profit societies etc).
* : Serve as the internal expert on registration and billing of state waiver and funding programs, ensuring all accounts are compliant with state vendor enrollment, audits and billing requirements.

bc724c427ab68b165524.description:
**Company Description**

Founded in 1903, Waltron Bull & Roberts is one of the world's oldest manufacturers of water chemistry analytical instruments. Our products are used by power plants and industrial customers worldwide to monitor and control critical water chemistry parameters.

We are seeking an experienced **Technical Customer Support Manager** to lead our customer support activities from our headquarters in Flemington, New Jersey.

**Position Description**

This is a hands-on management position responsible for ensuring that customers receive timely, competent, and effective technical support for Waltron's analytical instruments.

The successful candidate will manage technical support cases from initial contact through resolution, coordinate resources across service, engineering, manufacturing, and sales, and help identify opportunities to improve product reliability and customer satisfaction.

The position requires strong organizational and communication skills, practical technical aptitude, and a disciplined approach to problem-solving.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage customer technical support requests, ensuring timely responses, appropriate prioritization, and effective resolution.
* Oversee the creation, documentation, follow-up, and closure of customer support cases in our CRM system.
* Provide initial technical troubleshooting and coordinate more complex investigations with field service and engineering personnel.
* Lead cross-functional discussions to resolve recurring or difficult technical problems.
* Ensure equipment failures and customer complaints are properly documented and addressed in accordance with company quality procedures.
* Coordinate field-service responses with the Service Manager and other company resources.
* Maintain clear, professional communication with customers throughout the resolution process.
* Monitor customer support performance, identify recurring problems, and recommend improvements to procedures, products, and service delivery.
* Work closely with Sales, Engineering, and Operations to ensure customer problems are resolved effectively and lessons learned are incorporated into company processes.

Qualifications

* At least three years of relevant experience in technical customer support, industrial equipment service, instrumentation, or a related technical field.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot technical problems systematically and coordinate their resolution.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to timely follow-through.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly to customers.
* Experience with CRM or case management systems; Salesforce experience is desirable.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different functions.
* Familiarity with technical documentation, quality management systems, and structured corrective-action processes is desirable.
* Experience with analytical instrumentation, industrial process equipment, water treatment, or laboratory equipment is an advantage but not essential.

An engineering degree is not required. Relevant technical experience, sound judgment, and demonstrated problem-solving ability are more important.

As a veteran-owned small business, Waltron particularly values integrity, initiative, teamwork, and a strong service ethic. Military technical experience and community service are welcome qualifications.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Annual salary: $75,000-90,000, depending on experience.
* Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for subsidized medical, dental, and life insurance as well as the company 401k profit sharing plan.
* Full-time, permanent position based in Flemington, New Jersey.
* Travel to customer sites may be required.
* Relocation assistance is not available.

00c263c667682db28856.title: VP, Customer Care
00c263c667682db28856.description:
**Who we are:**  
Through a partnership-based approach, Coterie helps insurance professionals unlock untapped revenue in the small commercial space. With an innovative quoting platform that delivers accurate pricing and bindable quotes in less than one minute, Coterie makes small business insurance effortless.  
  
We are on a mission to build and foster a world-class team to bring speed, simplicity, and service to commercial insurance. We value integrity, humility, passion, and intelligence. If you want to push yourself and reshape a $200B+ market, we’re excited to talk to you!

**Position Summary:**

The VP, Customer Care is the leader responsible for building and running the Service Center and the scalable Care Center around it: the organizational structure, leadership team, operating model, sourcing strategy, and technology foundation required to support the company’s growth. Reporting to executive leadership, this role ensures agents and policyholders receive consistent, high-quality experience while the operation grows efficiently and predictably.

This leader owns the Care Center budget and end-to-end service delivery across calls, chats, emails, and digital channels, supporting policy changes, endorsements, payments, renewals, claims inquiries, and escalations. A core part of the role is determining the right blend of in-house teams, outsourced partners, automation, and AI to deliver that service, in close partnership with Sales, Underwriting, Claims, Product, Technology, Procurement, and Compliance.

At Coterie, service is part of how we grow. Thousands of independent agents, brokers, and digital partners rely on us to make small business insurance easy, and every call, chat, and email either strengthens that relationship or puts it at risk. When an agent gets a fast, knowledgeable answer, they send us their next submission. When a policyholder who bought coverage through a partner has a smooth experience, they renew. The Care Center serves two audiences, agents and policyholders, each with different needs. Its performance shows up directly in retention, partner loyalty, and revenue.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement a scalable Care Center operating model, including organizational structure, support tiers, specialized queues (agent vs. policyholder, billing, claims inquiries, escalations), spans of control, and service level standards.
* Define roles, career paths, and the leadership hierarchy needed to grow volume and headcount without degrading service.
* Establish workforce management practices, including forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and staffing ratios, that flex with growth, seasonality, and new product launches.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing leadership team of directors and managers, including identifying talent, setting accountability through scorecards and goals, making difficult personnel decisions, and building succession plans for key roles.
* Build and launch the Service Center inside the Coterie Care Center, owning site and channel setup, systems readiness, and go-live, and hiring and training the founding team.
* Run day-to-day Service Center operations against clear performance standards (service level, handle time, quality, first-contact resolution, satisfaction), including real-time queue management, quality and coaching programs, and readiness for volume spikes from renewals, billing cycles, catastrophe events, and new product launches.
* Develop and maintain standardized processes, SOPs, escalation protocols, and knowledge management practices that keep the operation consistent across teams, locations, and partners.
* Establish KPIs, reporting frameworks, and executive dashboards, with a regular cadence of weekly operating metrics, monthly business reviews, and quarterly strategy reviews.
* Own the Care Center budget and serve as its primary point of accountability to executive leadership, reporting on performance, cost-to-serve, customer experience, emerging risks, and investment priorities.
* Develop and execute outsourcing strategy, including deciding which work stays in-house and which is outsourced (overflow, after-hours, seasonal peaks, back-office processing) based on complexity, regulatory risk, cost, and customer impact.
* Lead BPO partner selection, contracting, onboarding, and transition with Procurement, Legal, and Compliance, and hold partners to internal standards through SLAs, scorecards, business reviews, and audit rights.
* Identify and lead opportunities to apply self-service, automation, and AI to high-volume contact drivers, and measure the impact on containment, handle time, quality, cost-to-serve, and customer and agent satisfaction.
* Partner with Technology, Product, Security, and Compliance to evaluate and implement CRM, telephony/CCaaS, workforce management, and AI solutions with appropriate human oversight, testing, and controls.
* Develop business cases and multi-year roadmaps for staffing, outsourcing, technology, and AI investments, with clear ROI and success measures.
* Drive continuous improvement and root-cause analysis to improve first-contact resolution and reduce avoidable contact volume.
* Collaborate with Sales, Underwriting, Claims, Product, and Technology to ensure operational readiness for new products, initiatives, and system changes.
* Ensure Care Center operations and outsourced partners meet licensing, regulatory, security, privacy, and audit requirements, partnering with Legal, Compliance, and Internal audit.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Operations Management, or related field required; MBA preferred.
* 10+ years leading large, multi-channel contact center organizations, including senior leadership roles with budget ownership and a proven track record of scaling an operation through significant growth.
* Insurance industry experience, ideally in property and casualty.
* Demonstrated experience designing organizational structures and hiring, developing, and when necessary, exiting leaders at multiple levels.
* Hands-on experience evaluating, contracting, and managing outsourced/BPO partners, including vendor governance and SLA management.
* Experience selecting and implementing contact center automation and AI solutions (e.g., conversational AI, agent assist, speech analytics) with measurable implementations

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Strong strategic and operational leadership capabilities.
* Working knowledge of policy servicing, billing, renewals, claims, and the regulatory standards that govern them.
* Deep expertise in workforce management, forecasting, capacity planning, and service level management.
* Proficiency in continuous improvement methods such as Lean or Six Sigma.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to build scalable processes and drive operational improvement.
* Executive presence, with experience presenting business cases, performance, risk, and investment recommendations to executive leadership.
* Problem solving mindset.

**Our interview process:**

Our hiring process generally consists of 4 phases. The goal is to provide an opportunity for us to learn more about our candidates while allowing them to get to know us as well!

* **Phase 1**: Qualified candidates will first meet with a member of our People Operations team for a phone interview. This discussion is a high-level conversation to understand more about your background and interests and for us to share more about Coterie and the position.
* **Phase 2**: Selected candidates will be invited to meet with our Hiring Manager for a 2nd interview via Teams video. This interview is designed to be more detail oriented and allows you to learn more about the role and expected to be 30 minutes in length.
* **Phase 3**: Top candidates will be invited to participate in an experiential interview exercise, which includes a project provided in advance. During the interview, candidates will have a 1-hour session with the hiring manager to present and discuss their project, followed by additional 1:1 interviews with team members. The full interview series is expected to take approximately 2-3 hours.
* **Phase 4:** Final candidates will receive an invite to our final interview that will include a 1:1 interview with a member of our senior leadership team. The final interview is roughly 30 minutes.

**What's in it for you:**

Coterie has excellent benefits for all full-time employees. We offer the following:

* 100% remote
* Health insurance through Aetna (we pay 100% of premiums)
* Dental and vision insurance through Guardian (we pay 100% of premiums)
* Basic life insurance (we pay 100% of premiums)
* Access to flexible spending account (FSA) or health savings account (HSA) (for those using HSA eligible plans)

cc8688d45bd34fa956aa.title: Director, Project Management
cc8688d45bd34fa956aa.description:
**About SH/FT**

Shift Paradigm is an execution-led strategic consultancy that bridges the gap between enterprise strategy and technical reality. We partner with Fortune 500 brands and emerging leaders to solve the inherent complexity of modern digital marketing. As partners to the world’s leading MarTech platforms, including Adobe, Salesforce, Optimizely, and Braze, we deploy integrated experts across data analytics, marketing strategy, technology development, engineering, and revenue operations to ensure our clients’ tech stacks don't just exist, but perform.

**The Role**

Reporting to COO/CFO, the Director, Project Management leads Shift Paradigm's Project Management practice. They also own the delivery operations that keep the business running: resourcing, forecasting, tooling and process.

This role leads a combined team of Strategic Project Managers and Technical Project Managers across campaign delivery, web development, CMS migration, martech implementation and managed-services engagements. It protects both client outcomes and company margin.

You will set the standard for how work is scoped, planned, resourced and delivered at Shift. In practice, PMs "manage the micro with a macro mindset." They are the single point of contact for delivery teams, the early warning system for risk and scope creep, and the owners of financial accuracy on their engagements.

You will be a trusted partner to Client Partners, Department Heads, Finance and executive leadership. You will be the escalation point when delivery gets hard.

**What You'll Accomplish**
--------------------------

**Practice Leadership & People Management**

* Lead, coach and grow a team of Project Managers at various levels of seniority and with expertise areas. You will own hiring, onboarding, performance management, career pathing and day-to-day escalations.
* Define clear roles and responsibilities between PM, Client Partner and delivery leads, and reinforce them across the organization.
* Build team rituals that keep the practice connected and accountable while working remotely.

**Delivery Excellence & Margin Protection**

* Oversee delivery health across the portfolio: scope, timeline, budget burn, risk and client satisfaction.
* Hold PMs accountable for accurate data, written client approvals and clean change control. These are the basis of margin protection.
* Partner with Client Partners and Finance on monthly reviews, revenue recognition notes, invoice approvals and project/retainer closeouts.
* Step in on high-risk or escalated engagements. Lead recovery plans and hard client conversations when needed.

**Scoping, Pre-Sales & SOW Readiness**

* Bring delivery into the sales cycle. Partner with Client Partners and Department Heads during discovery and scoping so SOWs are realistic and staffable.
* Own and evolve scoping templates and estimation standards. Review SOWs for risk, dependencies, assumptions and timeline feasibility before signature.

**Resource Management & Capacity Planning**

* Oversee the Resource Management function. Direct report: Resource Manager.
* Own the resourcing playbook. It covers resource alerts, pre-resourcing (hiring) triggers, Workfront resource requests and fulfillment.
* Deliver utilization and forecasting insights to leadership. Flag capacity risks early and translate pipeline demand into hiring and contractor recommendations.
* Sponsor skills management and skills-matrix work so staffing decisions are based on real capability data.

**Operations, Tooling & Process Improvement**

* Own Workfront as the system of record for delivery: project templates, timesheets, dashboards, reporting and automation.
* Lead internal operations initiatives such as forecasting dashboards, scope-to-Workfront automation and job aid overhauls. Drive adoption through training and change management.
* Evaluate and introduce new tools, including AI-assisted workflows, that reduce PM administrative load and improve forecasting accuracy.
* Maintain PMO documentation, job aids and standards, and keep them current as the business changes.

**Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership**

* Partner with Client Success, Delivery leadership, Finance and People Ops on operating rhythms, pipeline reviews and planning.
* Present delivery, utilization and margin performance to executive leadership with clear recommendations.

**What You Bring**
------------------

Experience & Expertise

* 10+ years in project, program or delivery management, with 3+ years leading PM teams. Agency or professional services experience required.
* Proven track record delivering web development, CMS migration and/or marketing technology implementations (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager, Salesforce, Marketo, AEP).
* Deep experience in highly billable environments: scoping, burn tracking, utilization, margin management and revenue forecasting.
* Advanced Workfront experience (or comparable PPM tool), including configuration, reporting and resource management.
* Experience building or running resource management, capacity planning and forecasting processes.
* Track record of operational change: designing processes, building job aids and training, and driving adoption across teams.

Skills & Capabilities

* Experience with Waterfall, Agile/Scrum and hybrid delivery. Experience leading Product Owners or backlog-driven delivery is strongly preferred.
* Executive presence. Able to influence peers and leadership, and to be diplomatic or firm as needed to protect the team and the business.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication with clients, delivery teams and executives.
* Comfort using AI tools to improve team efficiency is a plus.
* PMP, CSM/CSPO or equivalent certification is a plus.

Mindset

* You are a builder. You are comfortable walking into a team that needs structure and creating it rather than waiting for it to arrive.
* You lead through clarity. Colleagues and teammates know where things stand with you. You surface recommendations early and outline the process to bring resolutions to life.
* You are flexible without being formless. You have strong opinions about how good delivery works, and you can adapt how you apply them to different clients, platforms, and team dynamics.
* You do not need a large team or a fully defined playbook to be effective. You are energized by building the thing, not just running it.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and impact
* Remote flexibility
* Collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives and innovative thinking
* Work that makes a measurable difference for your clients

**Why SHIFT:**
--------------

SHIFT is a consultancy built for transformation. We bridge the gap between marketing, data, and technology to unlock growth for some of the world's most recognized brands. At SHIFT you'll shape the future of how organizations connect with their customers through intelligent architecture, scalable systems, and the power of data-driven strategy.

**Comp & Benefits**
-------------------

The salary range for this role is $145,000 to $160,000 USD. Salary is based on several factors including but not limited to skillset, relevant education, level of experience, certifications, and scope of responsibilities.

In addition to base salary, SHIFT offers benefits such as medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, Life/AD&D, Flexible Paid Time Off, and various other ancillary benefits and perks.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities under the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Candidates must have current US or Canada work authorization. For US candidates, this employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the US.

No relocation assistance can be offered at this time.

All inquiries are held in strict confidence.

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
145,000 - 160,000 USD per year(Remote)

0d08928aabb9546d2f7e.description:
Job Description
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Associate Director, Patient Support Campaign Development Lead (CDL) will lead the development and execution of an integrated patient support plan for a new US Oncology asset. Working in strong alignment with the verticals within the Patient Engagement Center of Excellence (CoE), the CDL will translate brand strategy and patient, caregiver, access, affordability, adherence, field, and channel insights into coordinated, compliant solutions that help patients initiate and remain on therapy.The role will partner closely with the PSP Strategist, Field Reimbursement Strategist, Patient Navigator Strategist, Product Owner (PO), brand, market access, medical, legal, regulatory, privacy, operations, analytics, field, and agency partners to deliver a connected and measurable patient experience.
  
  
The role requires a builder and execution-focused mindset. The successful candidate will rapidly translate brand and enterprise strategies into asset-specific plans, consult with CoE subject matter experts, and deliver with speed and excellence. They will collaborate with the HCC Product Owner and other stakeholders to prioritize a high volume of patient support work across launch-critical needs, longer-term capability building, and run-the-business requirements. Success will require adaptability, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity without a complete playbook.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities:**  

* Partner closely with the PSP Strategist, Patient Navigator Strategist, Field Reimbursement Strategist, and other CoE subject matter experts to translate enterprise and brand strategy into an integrated, executable asset roadmap. Support patient journey design, service blueprinting, experience principles, segmentation, business requirements, launch sequencing, and post-launch optimization. The CDL enables and executes the strategy rather than independently owning the functional strategy.
* Consult with the appropriate strategists, insights partners, and analytics teams to identify support needs, friction points, drop-off moments, and unmet information needs. Translate approved insights into prioritized, testable interventions and execution requirements. KPI strategy, measurement frameworks, and dashboards will be led by the designated strategists in partnership with Business Insights and Analytics team, with the CDL ensuring execution is informed by and responsive to those measures.
* Shape access-process support across benefits verification, ePA, digital hub capabilities, case management, patient navigation, and patient-facing education or content. Ensure the experience is coordinated across hub operations and brand-owned channels.
* Partner with affordability and market access stakeholders to define appropriate support solutions, including copay programs, bridge programs, patient assistance pathways, and other approved affordability resources. Ensure clear eligibility, handoffs, and communications.
* Partner with PSP and brand strategists to execute adherence and persistence approaches across approved patient support channels. Clarify the distinction between PSP-led support and consumer-side brand adherence activities, and coordinate digital CRM engagement, educational tools, companion resources, and human-led support to improve initiation, persistence, and continuity of care.
* Translate approved brand and PSP strategies into platform-delivered direct-to-patient content and experiences. Partner with the HCC PO, appropriate strategists, and channel subject matter experts to establish and prioritize content requirements, channel roles, governance, integration, and execution across patient-facing digital and human touchpoints. Consumer-side DTP strategy remains brand-led, with the CDL enabling coordinated execution within the PSP experience.
* Partner closely with the Field Reimbursement Strategist and other field and access stakeholders to translate approved education strategy into executable requirements for FRM resources, HCP-facing education, sales-led education, and approved field tools. Maintain clear boundaries between patient support operations and promotional roles.
* Build an innovation pipeline for emerging patient-health solutions. Design pilots with clear hypotheses, compliance review, success measures, decision gates, and plans to scale, modify, or stop based on evidence.
* Create an integrated operating model across CoE verticals and the asset team. Build strong alignment to functional strategies, clarify decision rights and dependencies, manage timelines and escalation paths, and coordinate budget and vendor accountability. Collaborate with the HCC PO and other stakeholders to prioritize the work and lead cross-functional CRT reviews and launch-readiness discussions.
* Partner with the designated strategists and Gianno’s team, who will lead KPI strategy, measurement frameworks, and dashboards. Use performance insights to inform execution, surface optimization opportunities, and drive timely decisions while respecting privacy, data-use, and compliance requirements.
* Patient Engagement CoE Alignment.
* Partner with PSP, Patient Navigation, Field Reimbursement, insights, and other CoE strategists to translate the approved patient experience strategy into an executable roadmap. Representative outputs include business requirements, prioritized workplans, journey and service-blueprint inputs, launch sequencing, and execution governance.
* Define access support requirements and connect asset needs to hub capabilities. Representative outputs include ePA and digital-hub requirements, case-management workflows, navigation, and education needs.
* Co-develop compliant affordability pathways and communications. Representative outputs include copay, bridge, assistance pathway requirements; eligibility and handoff design.
* Execute coordinated digital, educational, and human support in partnership with the relevant functional strategists. Representative outputs include CRM requirements, education tools, companion pathways, escalation models, and coordinated handoffs.
* Translate approved brand, PSP, and channel strategies into platform-delivered experiences in collaboration with the HCC PO and channel subject matter experts. Representative outputs include prioritized content requirements, channel execution plans, governance, and measurement inputs.
* Translate field access needs into scalable education and resources. Representative outputs include FRM (Field resource Management) and HCP (Health Care Professional) education priorities, field feedback loop, and role clarity.
* Create and evaluate an evidence-based innovation pipeline. Representative outputs include pilot charters, hypotheses, success metrics, and scale/stop decisions.

**Required Education:**  

* College graduate with Bachelors Degree

**Preferred Education:**  

* College graduate with MBA

**Required Capabilities and Experience:**  

* Minimum 4 years of pharmaceutical marketing, healthcare consumer marketing, patient engagement, or commercial communications experience, with demonstrated responsibility for DTC or patient-facing campaigns.
* Experience leading patient support, patient engagement, access, affordability, adherence, patient services, customer experience, or related commercialization work in a regulated healthcare environment.
* Demonstrated ability to translate brand and functional strategies, patient insights, and stakeholder input into a prioritized roadmap, executable business requirements, and high-quality deliverables.
* Working knowledge of patient-access processes such as benefits verification, electronic prior authorization, hub services, case management, patient navigation, and patient-facing education.
* Understanding of affordability and adherence programs, including the operational, legal, regulatory, privacy, and reputational considerations associated with patient support.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority, align CoE verticals, clarify decision rights, manage dependencies, lead CRT reviews, and drive action through ambiguity.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize high-volume work across launch-critical deliverables, longer-term needs, and run-the-business requirements while managing agencies, vendors, budgets, statements of work, timelines, and quality expectations.
* Comfort using strategist-led KPIs, dashboards, and performance insights to define problems, establish execution priorities, assess performance, and make evidence-based optimization decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex operational topics into clear recommendations for senior leaders and working teams.
* Track record of delivering with speed and excellence, including the ability to independently run with brand strategy, consult the right subject matter experts, and maintain quality in a fast-moving launch environment.
* Highly adaptable and able to navigate complex, evolving operating models, competing priorities, and incomplete information with sound judgment and a solutions-oriented mindset.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* An aligned PSP strategy is translated into a clear patient experience roadmap, prioritized execution plan, governance model, and launch-ready deliverables before critical decisions and milestones.
* Patient access, affordability, adherence, direct-to-patient content, field education, and innovation workstreams operate as a connected experience rather than separate tactics.
* Business requirements, roles, owners, dependencies, priorities, budgets, risks, CRT decisions, and launch milestones are documented and actively managed with the HCC PO and relevant stakeholders.
* Launch solutions are delivered with speed and excellence and are compliant, operationally feasible, patient-centered, measurable, and ready for scale.
* Strategist-led KPIs and performance insights are converted into specific execution and optimization actions, with documented decisions to scale, modify, or stop activities.

**Required Skills:**  
Accountability, Accountability, Adaptability, Agile Methodology, Collaboration, Commercialization, Communication Sciences, Customer-Focused, Digital Marketing Management, Digital User Experience, Experience Design (XD), Functional Strategy, Health Care, Market Development, Marketing Campaign Development, Marketing Strategy Implementation, Market Research, Oncology, Oncology Marketing, Patient Access, Patient Assistance, Patient Care, Patient Education, Patient Engagement, Patient Navigation {+ 8 more}

e5ac898773444172fda4.title: Director of Pharmacy Operations
e5ac898773444172fda4.description:
GapRx is seeking a Director of Pharmacy Operations to lead and support pharmacy operations across our growing client portfolio. This hands-on leadership role combines client-site operational oversight, new pharmacy implementation, project management, team development, and direct pharmacist practice.

### **About GapRx 340B Consultants, LLC**

GapRx 340B Consultants, LLC offers variety of solutions to federally qualified health centers around consulting and management of in-house & contract pharmacies and meeting their compliance needs.

### **Description**

The ***Director of Pharmacy Operations*** will serve as a trusted operational resource for GapRx and our healthcare clients. This individual will regularly travel to client locations to evaluate pharmacy operations, resolve operational challenges, support pharmacy teams, oversee implementations, assist with opening new pharmacy locations, and provide pharmacist coverage when needed.

The ideal candidate can move confidently between the pharmacy counter, an implementation project, and a client leadership meeting. This person should be comfortable entering an unfamiliar operation, quickly assessing its needs, building relationships with the team, and implementing practical improvements.

This is a *hybrid or remote role* with frequent work at client pharmacy and healthcare locations.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**

**Pharmacy Operations Leadership**

* Provide onsite and remote operational oversight and support for GapRx client pharmacies.
* Evaluate pharmacy workflow, staffing, inventory, purchasing, dispensing operations, patient service, and overall performance.
* Identify operational gaps and work with pharmacy and client leadership to implement practical, sustainable solutions.
* Develop and standardize pharmacy workflows, policies, procedures, checklists, and operational best practices.
* Support inventory management, purchasing optimization, wholesaler relationships, pharmacy technology, operational assessments, mock audits, readiness reviews, and corrective actions.
* Monitor priorities across client locations and ensure timely follow-through on agreed action items.

**New Pharmacy Implementation and Openings**

* Lead or support new pharmacy implementations from planning through post-opening stabilization.
* Develop and manage work plans, timelines, readiness checklists, risks, dependencies, and ownership.
* Coordinate licensing, credentialing, pharmacy technology, wholesaler and vendor setup, initial inventory, staffing, training, workflow design, policies and procedures, operational testing, and opening readiness.
* Collaborate with client leadership, pharmacists, vendors, technology partners, and GapRx team members.
* Provide onsite support before, during, and after go-live and complete post-opening operational assessments.

**Client-Site Operations and Oversight**

* Travel regularly to GapRx client locations and serve as an onsite operational representative of GapRx.
* Conduct pharmacy walkthroughs, staff interviews, workflow reviews, and operational assessments.
* Work effectively with pharmacy managers, pharmacists, technicians, clinical teams, administrative teams, and executive leadership.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, patient experience, inventory controls, staffing, accountability, and financial performance.
* Develop actionable follow-up plans, clarify ownership, monitor completion, and help clients implement GapRx recommendations.

**Pharmacist Coverage**

* Maintain an active pharmacist license in good standing and satisfy applicable continuing education and professional requirements.
* Provide PRN pharmacist coverage during vacancies, PTO, staffing transitions, pharmacy openings, and other temporary client needs.
* Perform pharmacist duties in accordance with applicable laws, Board of Pharmacy requirements, organizational policies, and professional standards.
* Obtain and maintain additional state pharmacist licenses when reasonably required to support GapRx clients.

**Pharmacy Program and 340B Support**

* Collaborate with the GapRx team on pharmacy and 340B-related operational initiatives.
* Help ensure pharmacy workflows support client program requirements, internal controls, and documentation expectations.
* Assist with operational implementation of in-house and contract pharmacy strategies.
* Support inventory, purchasing, dispensing, replenishment, referral, and pharmacy workflow initiatives.

**Leadership and Project Management**

* Partner directly with GapRx executive leadership on pharmacy operations, client service, and growth initiatives.
* Manage multiple client priorities and pharmacy projects while maintaining clear documentation and communication.
* Establish accountability for timelines, deliverables, risks, decisions, and follow-up items.
* Provide concise updates regarding client operations, risks, challenges, and opportunities.
* Develop scalable GapRx playbooks, templates, implementation processes, and operational standards.
* Train and mentor pharmacy and GapRx team members and represent GapRx professionally with clients and partners.

**Qualifications and Education Requirements**

* PharmD or Bachelor of Science in Pharmacy from an accredited school or college of pharmacy.
* Active pharmacist license in good standing. Georgia licensure is preferred; ability to obtain additional licenses is required when needed.
* Minimum of 3-5 years of pharmacy practice experience, preferably in community, retail, outpatient, or health-system outpatient pharmacy.
* Demonstrated pharmacy leadership, pharmacy management, implementation, or operational improvement experience.
* Strong knowledge of pharmacy workflow, inventory management, purchasing, third-party billing, dispensing systems, and pharmacy compliance.
* Ability to independently assess an operation, identify root causes, prioritize risks, and implement solutions.
* Ability and willingness to provide direct pharmacist coverage and travel approximately 30-50%, including periodic overnight travel.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to satisfy applicable client-site and travel requirements.
* Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, organizational, and project-management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Pharmacy Manager, Pharmacist-in-Charge, regional, or multi-site leadership experience.
* Experience opening, relocating, expanding, or implementing a pharmacy.
* Experience managing pharmacists and pharmacy technicians.
* Experience with wholesalers, inventory systems, dispensing platforms, credentialing, PBMs, payer enrollment, or pharmacy contracting.
* Experience with community health centers, federally qualified health centers, or other outpatient healthcare organizations.
* Knowledge of 340B pharmacy operations. Prior 340B experience is preferred but not required.
* Project management, process improvement, or implementation experience.
* Pharmacist licensure in multiple states.

**Working Conditions and Physical Requirements**

* ***Georgia-based*** candidate preferred
* ***Hybrid or remote work*** with frequent work at client pharmacy and healthcare locations.
* ***Approximately 30-50% travel***, with frequency varying based on implementations, client needs, and coverage requirements.
* Periodic overnight travel and occasional schedule flexibility may be required.
* Ability to perform the essential physical duties of a practicing pharmacist, including prolonged standing, routine computer use, and movement of typical pharmacy supplies, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Compensation and Benefit**

Expected base salary range: ***$140,000-$160,000 annually***, commensurate with experience, licensure, pharmacy leadership background, travel availability, and operational expertise.

Travel expenses are paid or reimbursed separately in accordance with GapRx policy. Eligibility for benefits and incentive compensation will be based on the final employment agreement and applicable GapRx plans.

**Other Duties and Employment Statement**

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, qualifications, or working conditions. GapRx may modify responsibilities based on business and client needs. The employee may be asked to perform other duties reasonably related to the role.

GapRx is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without unlawful discrimination and in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local requirements. Reasonable accommodations will be considered for qualified individuals with disabilities.

**About GapRx**

GapRx is a pharmacy and 340B consulting organization that partners with healthcare organizations to develop, implement, and optimize pharmacy programs. We work alongside our clients from strategy through execution, including pharmacy implementation, ongoing operational oversight, workflow optimization, compliance support, and day-to-day problem solving. Our approach is hands-on: we do not simply make recommendations; we help clients build, improve, and operate successful pharmacy programs.

#### **Salary**

$140,000 - $160,000 per year

45a3f581e6599a36e30a.title: Associate Director, Registrar Operations Evaluations and Articulation
45a3f581e6599a36e30a.description:
**Compensation Range:**

Annual Salary: $63,720.00 - $86,020.00

**Position Summary**

The Associate Director of Registrar Operations is responsible for planning, managing, and overseeing all evaluation and articulation processes/procedures, and responsibilities within the Registrar’s Office. This position ensures and manages that accurate assessment of academic credentials, transfer credits, transfer equivalencies, and articulations are compliant with institutional policies and accreditation standards. The Associate Director is responsible for managing, overseeing, and facilitating articulations for the University, both domestic and foreign including the system affiliate pathways to and from NU. This role oversees transfer equivalencies and timely updating into the Transfer Equivalency System (TES) and is responsible for leading and managing a team of evaluators and articulation specialist while verifying quality assurance of staff/procedures. This role collaborates with academic departments to maintain articulation agreements and work closely with advising and admissions teams to support seamless transfer pathways for students. They are responsible for enhancing the efficiency of evaluation processes and developing strategies to improve the transfer credit experience for students while ensuring consistency and transparency in the application of academic policies. In addition, this role is responsible for leading and expanding the development of new articulation agreements and partnerships with both internal and external parties.

**Essential Functions:**

* Provide day-to-day leadership to staff including but not limited to recruiting, selecting, orienting, coaching, mentoring, training, and disciplining employees, as well as developing personal growth opportunities.
* Develops and trains staff members on new processes and procedures and creates guides and job aids for reference
* Provides professional development through scheduled monthly 1:1 sessions and creates ongoing opportunities for all staff members
* Monitors current processes, procedures and workflows to ensure evaluation, and processing timelines are met timely and within required timeframes
* Set priorities and organize workflow to ensure timely evaluation o degree-seeking students, as well as bachelor’s degree verification and multiple career evaluation of Graduate and Doctoral students.
* Organize and oversee the allocation of course waivers for Graduate students, concurrent enrollments, plan changes, and other electronic forms.
* Establish and monitor a system of quality control to ensure the accuracy and quality of academic records and team performance. This includes quality-checking student files, auditing reports, and collecting data on team performance.
* Partners with Registrar Leaders to develop, refine, and improve evaluation and articulations services and processes.
* Evaluate and compare current and desired state and share ideas and strategies for improvement of processes and customer service outcomes throughout the evaluations and articulations area of the Registrar’s Office.
* Determine the number, level, and nature of course work being transferred from domestic institutions, including credit-by-exam, and other non-traditional credit, and determine its specific application to general education and/or preparation for the major, minor, or elective requirements of degree programs.
* Oversees the Anthology checklist process including the receipt of all mailed documents, electronic transcripts, scanning, and verifying of all documents. Coordinates with advisors regarding problems with academic files.
* Collects and records key performing metrics used to analyze department and team member outcomes and performance
* Analyzes daily operation trends in order to establish department goals, priorities, organizing workflow and ensures short-and-long-term goals are met, including making recommendations to senior management to improve student services.
* Initiate intervention strategies to drive towards continuous improvement and outcomes
* Establish and maintain communication with all academic and support services offices; propose, coordinate, and implement new applications for improving customer service and procedures to improve efficiency of operations.
* Establishes and sustains communication with academic and support services offices. Proposes, facilitates and implements new applications for improving customer service and procedures to improve operational success
* Expedites resolutions to students, advisors, faculty and staff with concerns, issues or complaints. Collaborates with Department leadership to organize and accelerate resolution of topic. Serves as a resource for students, faculty, staff regarding academic policies and procedures
* Collaborates with management on the Cal Grant Grade Point Average (GPA) submission for the University including online submission form and assuring students information accuracy.
* Sustains thorough knowledge and understanding of the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) including explaining provisions of legislation to individuals, as appropriate.
